#en: The freighter drifts dark between lanes, power bled down to the bare minimum, perfect cover for records no one wants in a public ledger. This hull is where routes are laundered and cargo histories scrubbed; any list that survives in its systems was meant for backroom whispers, not audits. If Vector has bent Trade Authority shipping to feed her ghost-yards, the pattern of those corrections will be etched in whatever manifests escaped the purge, buried in a ship no one bothers to tow home.  \n\nSo far the trail runs from a forgotten rock with a discarded dataslate to a silent UC relay full of half-erased sensor logs, each hinting at the same unseen pilot nudging traffic just off the charted lanes.
zh: 那艘货船黑暗地漂在航道之间，电力被抽到最低限度，是那些没人想放进公开账册的记录最好的掩护。这具船壳正是航线被洗白、货物历史被擦净的地方；凡是能在它系统里留下来的清单，都是为密室低语、而非审计准备的。如果"向量"弯折了贸易管理局的航运来喂养她的幽灵船坞，那些修正的模式就会镌刻在任何逃过清理的舱单上，埋在一艘没人费心拖回家的船里。  \n\n目前为止，线索从一块带着被丢弃数据板的被遗忘岩石，延伸到一座塞满半擦除传感器日志的沉默联殖中继，每一处都暗示着同一名隐形飞行员正把交通推向已标注航道的边缘。

#en: In the deserted listening post, old routines still hum beneath the dust, automated sweeps ticking through sky they no longer officially watch. Somewhere in that forgotten rhythm, the records of a ship that should not exist kept slipping past, its course adjustments smoothed over by systems no human bothered to review. This is where the first lie took root, not as a grand conspiracy but as a neglected process, quietly folding an outlaw's path into the background noise. All I know so far is that a dead station saw something the public charts never recorded, and that someone valued those overlooked readings enough to send a gang like Heat Ridge to sit on them long after everyone else stopped caring.
zh: 在那座废弃的听音哨里，旧程序仍在尘土之下嗡鸣，自动扫描仍在扫过它们已不再官方监视的天空。在那被遗忘的韵律中，一艘不该存在的船的记录不断溜过，它的航向修正被那些没人费心复核的系统抹平。这里正是第一个谎言的扎根之处——不是一场宏大的阴谋，而是一个被忽视的流程，悄悄把一个法外之徒的路径折进背景噪声。目前为止我只知道，一座死掉的监测站看见了公开星图从不曾记录的东西，而有人珍视那些被忽略的读数到愿意派出"热脊帮"这样的帮派，在其他所有人都不再关心之后还守着它们。

#en: Only a dead warship can keep secrets this loud. The KN-7893 drifts where the old grav tests tore space thin, its UC markings scoured by storms and weapons fire, yet its navigation heart still cradling the routes no one will acknowledge were ever flown. Whatever pattern Stormline is following was born in these corridors, plotted on these consoles, and buried under layers of classified silence; without this link, every rumor about storm corridors and vanishing convoys remains conveniently deniable. Back on the frontier outpost, settlers spoke in half-finished sentences, and the liaison's reports were redacted to ribbons, all circling the same unspoken truth that led straight to this forgotten hull.
zh: 只有一艘死掉的军舰才装得住这么震耳欲聋的秘密。"KN-7893"漂在旧日引力试验把空间扯薄的地方，它的联殖标识被风暴与炮火磨蚀，可它的导航心脏仍捧着那些无人愿意承认曾被飞过的航线。"风暴线"所追随的那个模式，正是在这些走廊里诞生、在这些控制台上绘出、并被埋进层层机密沉默之下；没有这一环，所有关于风暴走廊与消失车队的传闻就都能方便地矢口否认。回到边境前哨，定居者们说话只说半句，联络官的汇报被涂黑成布条，全都绕着同一个未曾说出口、却直通这具被遗忘船壳的真相打转。

#en: Out here, just above a nameless world, the stars look clean and honest, but the thing humming in its lonely track is anything but; it is a hidden hand on the grav wheel, nudging ships toward the same quiet graves you have been hearing about in spacer bars. Whoever built it trusted that distance and vacuum would keep curious eyes away, that the Settled Systems would accept another bad approach as simple misfortune, not guided intent. Yet the checksum scars in LIST backlogs, the scorched pads at forgotten farms, and the way smugglers in the dark corners of stations all murmur about rerouted settlers prove someone tried to bury the pattern and failed, because their own victims would not stop talking.
zh: 在这里、在一颗无名世界正上方，群星看上去干净而诚实，可在那孤零零的轨道上嗡鸣的东西绝非如此；它是一只搭在引力舵轮上的隐形之手，把船只推向你在太空劫匪酒吧里早已听闻的那些安静坟墓。建造它的人笃信，距离与真空能挡住好奇的眼睛，笃信定居星系会把又一次糟糕的进近当成纯粹的霉运、而非受引导的意图。然而独立盟积压记录里的校验和伤痕、被遗忘农场里烧焦的停机坪，以及星际站阴暗角落里走私者们对"被改道定居者"的齐声低语，都证明有人试图埋掉这个模式却失败了——因为他们的受害者自己不肯闭嘴。

#en: Out here, alone above a nameless world, there is nothing to drown out the whisper of altered routes and dead fleets drifting just beyond sensor range. This orbit is not random; it sits exactly where a careful navigator would splice a hidden branch into a main shipping lane, then scrub the trace behind them. Whoever parked the HX-5912 Ironstrike here is guarding more than cargo, they are sitting on the seam where open traffic brushes against Vector's private lattice of war ghosts and lost convoys. In quieter ports, no one says her callsign out loud anymore, they just mention odd beacon behavior, a buried dataslate on an empty rock, and ship logs from Neon that never quite match the official charts.
zh: 在这里、孤悬于一颗无名世界之上，没有任何东西能盖过被改动航线的低语，以及就在传感器范围外漂着的死掉舰队。这条轨道并非随机；它恰好位于一个谨慎的领航员会把隐藏支线接进主航运道、再抹掉身后痕迹的地方。把"铁击 HX-5912"停在这里的人守护的不只是货物——他们坐在开阔交通与"向量"那张由战争幽灵与失踪车队构成的私人网格相擦的那道缝上。在更安静的港市里，已经没人把她的呼号念出声了，他们只会提起奇怪的信标行为、空岩石上一块被埋的数据板，以及来自霓虹城、永远对不上官方星图的船舶日志。

#en: This tower is where the numbers live, stripped of faces and excuses. Whatever Rourke seeded out on the frontier started as clean graphs and controlled trials in places like this, before it was poured into soil and set loose. The people guarding these halls now are drifters and ghosts, hired blades who only know the paymaster two names up the chain and repeat rumors in half-sentences when the lights flicker. Somewhere in these sealed records is the link between backwater homesteads that stopped behaving like themselves, a crippled beacon whispering bad telemetry, and a courier's twisted flight paths, each fragment pointing toward a pilot who has been flying just outside the edges of everyone's maps.
zh: 这座塔就是那些数字居住的地方，剥去了面孔与借口。鲁尔克在边境播下的东西，起初只是这种地方里干净的图表与受控试验，之后才被倒进土壤、放了出去。如今守着这些回廊的，是流浪者与幽灵、拿钱办事的刀手——他们只认得链条往上的两个名字，在灯光闪烁时只说得半句话的传闻。在这些密封记录里的某处，藏着那些不再像自己的穷乡农场、一座低语着糟糕遥测的残废信标，以及一名信使扭曲的飞行路径之间的联系；每一块碎片都指向一名一直飞在所有人星图边缘之外的飞行员。

#en: The trail bends into this cavern because smugglers prefer stone and silence when they move things they never intend to declare. Here, beneath the rock and humming generators, a quartermaster tallies favors and dead drops that never make it onto official manifests, keeping his records close in case the people above ever decide he is expendable. Those entries tie war salvage, redirected haulers, and quiet payments to a single pattern of jumps that only one navigator could have built.  \nSo far, the path runs from a forgotten outpost to mismatched dock logs near Neon and a corrupted orbital trace, each step hinting that whole shipping lanes are being rewritten in the gaps everyone claims not to recall.
zh: 线索拐进这座洞窟，是因为走私者在运送那些他们从不打算申报的东西时，偏爱石头与沉默。在这里、在岩石与嗡鸣的发电机之下，一名军需官清点着那些永远进不了官方舱单的人情与死信点，把记录留在身边，以防上面的人哪天决定他可以被牺牲。那些条目把战争打捞物、被改道的货船与压低声音的付款，系到同一个只有一名领航员才建得出来的跃迁模式上。  \n目前为止，这条路从一座被遗忘的前哨，延伸到霓虹城附近对不上的船坞日志与一道损坏的轨道痕迹，每一步都暗示：整条整条的航运道正被改写进所有人都声称记不得的那些空隙里。

#en: Out here, the fields sit directly beneath the worst of the Akila Dust Corridor, where every shipment walks a knife-edge between salvation and a crater. Locals say someone has been riding the storms for them, slipping in unseen on suicide vectors and whispering course changes over dead channels the way priests used to mumble prayers. If he walks away from this ridge, he keeps the sky itself as leverage over every freighter, every settler, every missing manifest no one will ever admit to. People talk about a frozen lab where beacons were bent to twist approach paths, and a dead Navy hauler with hand-entered vectors that all carried the same ghost of a voice, the one every rumor insists belongs to him.
zh: 在这里，农田就坐落于阿基拉沙尘走廊最恶劣的那段正下方，每一次货运都走在救赎与弹坑之间的刀刃上。当地人说，有人替他们驾驭风暴，以自杀式的向量无声潜入，在死掉的频道上低声念出航向改动，像神父从前喃喃祈祷那样。若他从这道山脊走脱，他就把天空本身握成了筹码，用以要挟每一艘货船、每一名定居者、每一份没人愿意承认的失踪舱单。人们谈论着一座冰封实验室——信标在那里被掰弯以扭曲进近路径；以及一艘死掉的海军货船——手工输入的向量全都带着同一个声音的幽灵，所有传闻都坚称那是他的声音。

#en: This forgotten relay bunker is where the grid once listened longest, a place built to catch every whisper that drifted past the patrol lines and hold it in cold storage until someone with clearance remembered to care. Concrete sweats, cables sag, and the old UC seal on the door looks more like a warning than a promise. Whatever passed through restricted airspace over Gravelight would have brushed these sensors first, leaving traces in systems designed to archive, not forgive, anomalies.  \n\nSo far the trail runs from a nameless backworld cache to a half-spoken tip in a station dive, all pointing toward altered registries, missing mass, and a rigger who keeps turning up just off the official record.
zh: 这座被遗忘的中继掩体，是这张网格曾经聆听最久的地方，一座用来捕捉每一句飘过巡逻线低语、并把它冷存起来、直到某个有权限的人想起要在意的设施。混凝土渗着水，线缆垂着，门上那枚旧联殖印章看起来更像警告而非承诺。凡是穿过"墓光"上空受限空域的东西，都会先擦过这些传感器，在那些为归档、而非为宽恕异常而设计的系统里留下痕迹。  \n\n目前为止，线索从一座无名穷乡储藏点，延伸到某家星际站廉价酒馆里一句只说了一半的线报，全都指向被改动的登记册、失踪的质量，以及一名总是恰好出现在官方记录之外的装配工。

#en: Out here, the air tastes like rust and recycled coolant, and the only thing moving is the dust drifting in a gravity profile that feels just slightly wrong. Whatever is leaching through the soil and rock at this spot carries the same subtle pull as those misaligned satellites and wayward storms; if anything ties his equations to a real place, it is whatever was bottled from ground like this. The story of that strange drift started as a half-joke in a miner's canteen, but every retelling stretched farther: from failed survey rigs, to a frontier moon's bad weather, to a dead relay's missing warnings, until the rumor walked itself all the way out here and waited for someone stubborn enough to follow it.
zh: 在这里，空气尝起来像铁锈与回收冷却液，唯一在动的东西，是在一种感觉略有不妥的引力轮廓里漂着的尘埃。从这片土壤与岩石中渗出的东西，带着与那些错位卫星和脱轨风暴相同的微妙牵引；若说有什么能把他那套方程系到一个真实的地点，那就是从这样的地面里装瓶带走的东西。那场古怪漂移的故事始于矿工食堂里的半句玩笑，可每一次重述都拉得更远：从失败的勘探设备，到某颗边境卫星的恶劣天气，再到一座死掉中继缺失的警告——直到这个传闻自己一路走到这里，等着某个足够固执的人跟上它。

#en: The rock field is where traffic goes to forget itself, a frozen storm of stone and scrap just far enough off the lanes that no one checks the logs too closely.  \nSomeone anchored a signal here years ago, probably meant as a temporary fix to patch a routing error, and then never pulled it down; that oversight left a permanent kink in local jump math, a quiet bend in space Vector has been folding his patterns through ever since.  \nYour previous finds all echo the same skew, from the corrupted registry in that backwater wreck to the misjump traces on the crippled freighter and the nervous directions whispered by relay clerks who keep seeing the same analyst's signature buried in their route corrections.
zh: 石场，就是交通前去遗忘自己的地方——一场由石头与废铁构成的冻结风暴，离航道足够远，没人会细查日志。  \n多年前有人在这里锚定了一个信号，大概本是为了临时修补一处航线错误，然后再没把它撤下来；那次疏忽在当地跃迁数学里留下了一个永久的扭结，一道安静的太空弯折——"向量"从此一直把他的模式折着穿过它。  \n你先前的发现都回响着同样的偏斜：从那具穷乡残骸里损坏的登记册，到那艘残废货船上错跳的痕迹，再到中继文书们紧张兮兮指出的方向——他们在自己的航线修正里不断看到同一名分析员的签名。

#en: The story has to end here, on a rock no one charts, where the air peels metal and the horizon is nothing but dust and static. It is the only place left where the routes she has bent all intersect, a last, ugly knot in the web she has been weaving between convoys and graveyards. In this forgotten installation she is purging consoles, reprogramming beacons, and priming dead man bursts that will fling her version of events across the lanes if no one stops her. The first teller of this tale vanished with a blood smeared slate at a backwater stop, then the pattern of renamed waypoints in a dead survey shack, then the orbital buoy guarded by Spacers that proved someone had been steering ships toward the guns.
zh: 这个故事必须在这里终结——在一块无人测绘的岩石上，那里的空气会剥蚀金属，地平线上只有尘土与静电。这是她弯折过的所有航线唯一还会交汇的地方，是她一直在车队与坟墓之间编织的那张网里最后一个丑陋的结。在这座被遗忘的设施里，她正在清理控制台、重编信标，并预备"死人开关"式的脉冲——若没人阻止她，那会把她的版本的事件甩遍所有航道。这则故事的第一个讲述者带着一块血迹斑斑的数据板在某个穷乡落脚点失踪，接着是一座死掉勘探棚里被改名的航点模式，再接着是那座由太空劫匪把守的轨道浮标——它证明有人一直在把船只引向枪口。

#en:
The Scarrunner hangs in a lazy tumble, lights dead, hull scarred like it scraped along the edge of bad math and lost.  
Whatever happened to its crew started here, when a freighter that always ran clean routes began shaving jumps too close to a certain debris field, adjusting course the same subtle way each time until the last one cracked it open.  
Buried in its systems will be the first hint of that shift, the moment standard procedures were replaced by someone else's numbers.  
So far all I have are a remote outpost's discarded slate and a handful of corrupted misjump traces; both whisper the same small deviations that no one noticed until wrecks started piling up in the same quiet corner of space.
zh:
疤痕快船懒洋洋地翻滚着，灯光熄灭，船壳上的伤痕像是沿着错误数学的边缘擦过然后输了。  
它船员遭遇的一切正是从这里开始的：一艘一直跑干净航线的货船，开始把跃迁削得离某片碎片场太近，每次都同样微妙地调整航向，直到最后一次把它撬开。  
埋在它系统里的，会是那次转变的最初迹象——标准程序被别人的数字取代的那一刻。  
目前为止，我只有一座偏远前哨被丢弃的数据板，以及几段损坏的错跳痕迹；两者都低语着同样那些没人注意到的小偏差，直到残骸开始在太空里同样安静的角落越堆越多。

#en: Buried in frozen soil and silence, the abandoned UC relay bunker is where the sky itself was supposed to be watched and forgotten. Here, atmospheric traces of ships slipping through restricted airspace were filed, rounded off, and eventually ignored by officers who preferred neat reports over messy truths. The deserter chose this place because the evidence was never meant to be seen twice, only summarized and shelved until the war stories dulled. But the same quiet hands that once pushed anomalies off the record could not stop the rumors; scraps of triage logs in the dust outside Akila, a nervous clerk in Gagarin, and a dispute in New Atlantis all pointed back to ships that died on paper yet kept flying.
zh: 埋在冻土与沉默之中，这座废弃的联殖中继掩体，本就是让天空被监视、然后被遗忘的地方。在这里，溜过受限空域的船只的大气痕迹被归档、被磨圆，最终被那些偏爱整齐报告甚于凌乱真相的军官忽略。那名逃兵选中这里，是因为这些证据本就不该被看第二次，只需被摘要并搁置，直到战争故事变得钝钝无趣。可那些曾把异常推离记录的安静之手，挡不住传闻；阿基拉城外尘土里零散的分诊日志、加加林星上一名紧张的文书，以及新亚特兰蒂斯城里一场争执，全都指回那些在纸面上死亡、却仍在飞行的船只。

#en: Coincidences pile up faster down here than trash in the gutters. Too many captains paid in quiet credits for runs that skirt the same empty patch of sky, too many street medics patching burns that do not match any weapon on the market, and a few data brokers suddenly very interested in old UC telemetry. This is where routes get bent, names get shaved off manifests, and somebody who understands jump physics a little too well can hide their trail inside other people's crimes. So far the path is a dead buoy with scrambled logs, a homestead field scarred like something tried to land sideways, and an orbiting station that heard the same static whisper three separate times before its crew called it malfunction.
zh: 在这下面，巧合堆积的速度比阴沟里的垃圾还快。太多船长收了安静的报酬、去跑那些擦过同一片空荡天空的航次；太多街头医生在缝合与市面上任何武器都对不上的灼伤；还有几个数据掮客突然对旧日的联殖遥测大感兴趣。这里正是航线被掰弯、名字被从舱单上刮掉的地方，也是一个对跃迁物理懂得稍微太多的人，能把自己的痕迹藏进别人罪行里的地方。目前为止，这条路是一枚日志被搅乱的死浮标、一片像被什么东西侧着降过而留下伤疤的农场田地，以及一座在船员称其为故障之前、三度听到同一句静电低语的轨道星际站。

#en: Only out in a ragged asteroid belt could someone hide a sensor web fine-tuned to listen for impossible jumps, far from traffic lanes and official eyes. The rocks scatter normal emissions, turning this patch of space into a blind spot where a careful hand can reroute ships and erase the evidence after. Whatever is anchored here is part of how the routes keep bending around patrol nets, and whoever set it up counted on drifting stone and forgotten survey charts to keep it quiet. So far the trail has been a scrubbed slate on a lonely rock and nervous research logs, all pointing toward altered corridors and a vanished navigator working in the gaps between what corporations admit and what spacers whisper about.
zh: 只有在一片嶙峋的小行星带里，才有人能藏起一张调校得专门聆听不可能之跃迁的传感器网，远离航道与官方的眼睛。岩石散射普通辐射，把这片太空变成盲点，一只谨慎的手可以在那里改道船只、事后抹掉证据。锚定在这里的东西，正是航线为何不断绕着巡逻网弯折的一部分；布置它的人仰赖漂移的岩石与被遗忘的勘探星图，让它保持安静。目前为止，这条线索是一块孤独岩石上被擦净的数据板与紧张的研究日志，全都指向被改动的走廊，以及一名在"公司承认的"与"太空劫匪低语的"之间空隙里运作的失踪领航员。

#en: Out here, away from port authority eyes and clean lanes, paperwork goes to die. This backwater depot is where manifests are rewritten in bad light, where haulers quietly adjust cargo tallies and no one checks the original transmission against what finally gets stamped. If there is a record of ships slipping off the books toward graveyards and forgotten wrecks, it will be buried in the half-corrupted traffic logs people swear are "just how they came in."  \nSo far I have a dead survey site with a stray dataslate, a handful of dockhands near Neon repeating the same story they all swear they heard from someone else, and a pattern of delays in frontier convoys that never quite matches the flight plans on file.
zh: 在这里，远离港务当局的眼睛与干净航道，文书就是来送死的。这座穷乡货运站正是舱单在糟糕灯光下被重写的地方，是货船船员悄悄调整货物清单、而没人拿原始传输去核对最终盖章内容的地方。若说还有船只溜出账册、驶向坟墓与被遗忘残骸的记录，它就会被埋在那半损坏的交通日志里——人们发誓那些日志"送来时就是这个样子"。  \n目前为止，我有一座带着散落数据板的死掉勘探场、几名在霓虹城附近反复讲述同一个故事、并都发誓是听别人说的码头工，以及一个从来对不上存档飞行计划的边境车队延误模式。

#en: The farm ring was never meant to last this long. Hydroponic modules were bolted onto the hull as a stopgap, a way to keep crews fed while corporate worked out a proper supply chain, then forgotten once the ledgers balanced. Years later, the improvised pipework and jury rigged circulation pumps have become part of the ship's skeleton, hiding new grafts in plain sight extra feeds drawing power, nutrient lines re routed to panels that do not grow anything at all. So far the trail runs from a dead buoy with missing minutes in its logs, through a homestead field scarred by a sideways landing, to smug Neon gossip about a pilot who keeps using "temporary" routes everyone else has quietly built their lives around.
zh: 那圈农场本就没打算撑这么久。水培舱当初只是被草草螺栓固定到船壳上应急，好让船员在公司理顺正经供应链之前有饭吃，账本一平衡就被忘掉了。多年之后，那些临时拼凑的管路与勉强凑合的循环泵已成船体骨架的一部分，把新的嫁接藏在众目睽睽之下：额外的供给在耗电，营养管线被改道到根本不长任何东西的种植板上。目前为止，线索从一枚日志里少了几分钟的死浮标，穿过一片被侧向降落留下伤疤的农场田地，延伸到霓虹城地下关于一名飞行员的自负闲谈——他一直在用那些"临时"航线，而其他所有人早已悄悄把生活建在了它们之上。

#en: This quiet farm sits at the edge of nowhere, exactly where someone obsessed with lost ships might hide a map no one is supposed to own. The fields swallow radio noise, the sky stays clear enough for clean grav readings, and the Waggoners already live with a memorial carved from unanswered calls. Whatever was tucked away here was meant to be found only by someone who has walked the same uncertain corridors of omission and edited reports. All we know for sure is fragmentary: a stray dataslate from a forgotten backworld, falsified manifests in a derelict freight yard, and an encrypted tag behind a candlelit plaque, each whispering about altered queues, missing settlers, and a salvager who always arrives first.
zh: 这座安静的农场坐落在天涯之外，恰好是一个痴迷于失踪船只的人会把一份"谁都不该拥有"的地图藏起来的地方。田野吞掉无线电噪声，天空足够清朗、能取得干净的引力读数，而瓦戈纳一家早已与一座由无人接听的呼叫雕成的纪念碑共处。藏在这里的东西，本就只该被某个走过同样那些充满省略与涂改报告的不确定走廊的人找到。我们确定知道的只有碎片：一块来自被遗忘穷乡的散落数据板、一座废弃货运场里被伪造的舱单，以及一块烛光牌匾背后的加密标签，每一处都低语着被改动的队列、失踪的定居者，以及一名总是最先抵达的打捞者。

#en: The beacon drifts in cold, orderly orbit, still slaved to old traffic updates that no one has read in months. This is where the numbers live, the forgotten routing errors and quiet hand-edits that let one tug, one courier, slip through the cracks while everyone trusted the system to catch them. Out here the noise of Neon, Gagarin, and every other crowded port falls away, leaving only the bare pattern of movements and falsified paths that point toward where a shipbreaker with a stolen past would flee. So far the trail runs from a lonely rock and a dead crew's memorial to altered manifests, whispers in the underbelly, and a SysDef log that all agree on one thing: someone hid him in the blind spots on purpose.
zh: 那座信标在冰冷而有序的轨道上漂着，仍被奴役于几个月来无人读过的旧交通更新。这里正是那些数字居住的地方——被遗忘的航线错误与悄悄的手工编辑，让一艘拖船、一艘信使船在所有人都相信系统会拦住它们时从缝隙里溜过。在这里，霓虹城、加加林星以及其他每一座拥挤港市的噪声都褪去，只剩下运动与伪造路径的赤裸模式，指向一个带着偷来的过往的拆船人会逃往何处。目前为止，线索从一块孤独的岩石与一座死掉船员的纪念碑，延伸到被改动的舱单、下层的低语，以及一份星防队日志——它们都同意一件事：有人故意把他藏进了盲点里。

#en: No other place in the Settled Systems concentrates her choices like this forgotten bionics lab, where corporate trial beds and discarded implants still remember the hands that wired them. Every corridor hums with half-finished ideas, emergency power bleeding into surgical frames and neural maps as she prepares to fold herself and her work into the circuitry forever. She has been stripping code from clinics and robotics sites, salvaging firmware and memories, all to rebuild the disaster that made her and decide who it burns this time. From the first shredded case files in that freestar trailer to the gutted machines at the robotics site, every small compromise and favor has curved the trail toward this table.
zh: 在整个定居星系里，没有别的地方像这座被遗忘的仿生学实验室一样，如此集中地呈现她的选择：公司的试验台与被丢弃的植入体，仍记得为它们接线的那双手。每条走廊都嗡鸣着半途而废的构想，应急电力渗进手术架与神经图谱——她正准备把自己和她的作品永久折进电路里。她一直在从诊所与机器人场址上剥离代码，回收固件与记忆，只为重建那场造就了她的灾难，并决定这一次它烧到谁。从那辆自由星系联盟拖车里被撕碎的最初案卷，到机器人场址里被掏空的机器，每一次小小的妥协与恩惠，都把这条线索弯向这张手术台。

#en: Down in Neon's dripping steel gut, where grid-light and storm-rumble bleed together, numbers change hands more quietly than drugs or guns. This is where routes are laundered into rumor, where a single stray calculation can shift a convoy toward profit or disaster without a clerk ever seeing the edit, and where her work has been sliced into saleable fragments. The ledgers and side-channel agreements buried here show which captains, brokers, and data techs have been buying her corrections, each swearing they only heard the pattern from someone else first. So far the trail runs from a redacted hearing in the capital to scattered freighter logs and a half-whispered name passed between LIST crews and Neon fixers.
zh: 在霓虹城滴着水的钢铁内脏里，电网的辉光与风暴的轰鸣交织，数字转手比毒品或枪械还安静。这里正是航线被洗成传闻的地方，一处零散的计算就能把一支车队推向利润或灾难、而文书从来看不见那次编辑的地方，也是她的作品被切成可售碎片的地方。埋在这里的账册与侧信道协议显示，哪些船长、掮客与数据技师一直在购买她的修正，每人都发誓自己只是先从别人那里听来这个模式。目前为止，线索从首都一场涂黑的听证会，延伸到零散的货船日志，以及一个在独立盟船员与霓虹城掮客之间传递的、只说了一半的名字。

#en: Out here, in the drift between rocks, is where someone hid the thing they meant to come back for. The beacon sits in the shadow of shattered stone, quietly listening to two channels at once, routing whispers from frontier habitats toward coordinates that do not appear on any civilian chart. Whoever set this up needed distance from prying traffic and enough clutter to lose a transponder trail, but the unfinished routing tables say they never returned to finish the job. So far the trail runs from shaken settlers at a remote retreat to a buried UC listening post and a derelict hangar full of cannibalized life support rigs, all pointing toward one engineer who treats entire colonies like numbers in an experiment.
zh: 在这里、在岩石之间的漂流带里，有人藏起了他们本打算回来取的东西。那座信标坐在碎石之影中，同时静静聆听两个频道，把来自边境聚居地的低语引向任何民用星图上都不存在的坐标。布置这一切的人需要远离窥探的交通，也需要足够多的杂物来抹掉应答器痕迹，但那些未完成的航线表说明，他们再没回来完成这项差事。目前为止，线索从某处偏远隐居地受惊的定居者，延伸到一座被埋的联殖听音哨与一座塞满被拆解生命维持装置的废弃机库，全都指向一名把整片殖民地当作实验中数字的工程师。

#en: Neon's underside is where systems go to be forgotten, not repaired. Down here, between leaking condensers and flickering conduits, maintenance subroutines and flow controllers keep cycling long after anyone remembers who wrote them or why. If he wanted a place where old logic could keep quietly routing air, water, and data along paths no one audits anymore, this is it. Tapping into those loops will show which corridors he has been riding under the city's nose, and where they empty out once they leave Volii's shadow. So far, the trail runs from a dead rock to a silenced cargo hull, and now to a buried heartbeat in Neon's machinery that has been following his numbers for years without a single human signing off.
zh: 霓虹城的底面，是系统前去被遗忘、而非被修理的地方。在这下面，在渗漏的冷凝器与闪烁的导管之间，维护子程序与流量控制器在所有人都忘了是谁、为何写下它们之后仍不断循环。如果他想要一个让旧逻辑继续悄悄沿着再无人审计的路径输送空气、水与数据的地方，那就是这里。接入那些循环，就能看出他一直在城市眼皮底下走哪些走廊，以及它们离开沃利星的阴影后在哪里倾泻而出。目前为止，线索从一块死岩石到一具被噤声的货船壳，如今又到霓虹城机械里一处被埋藏的心跳——它追随他的数字多年，却没有一个人类签过字。

#en: Tucked into the rock far from any beacon, the pirate relay shack is where bad habits go to rot; smugglers trust it, officials ignore it, and its consoles hum on the same unattended cycles they have used for years. That is why the fragments you are after had to land here: a forgotten junction where altered routes and duplicated bands could slide into storage without triggering alarms, just another day s smuggling traffic until someone finally noticed the pattern. The broker who hid them counted on complacency, on the way routines changed quietly after that dead Navy freighter and those hushed payments to backwater clinics, all lining up with blackout scars on frontier farms no one wanted to write reports about.
zh: 那座嵌在岩石里、远离任何信标的走私者中继小屋，是坏习惯前去腐烂的地方；走私者信任它，官员无视它，而它的控制台仍以多年来同样的无人值守周期嗡鸣。正因如此，你要找的那些碎片才必须落在这里：一处被遗忘的枢纽，被改动的航线与重复的频段可以在不被触发警报的情况下溜进存储，一切不过是又一个走私交通的日常——直到终于有人注意到这个模式。藏起它们的掮客赌的是人们的自满，赌那艘死掉的海军货船、以及付给穷乡诊所的那些压低声音的款项之后，惯例会如何被悄悄改动——而这一切都与边境农场那些没人愿意写报告的黑障伤痕对得上。

#en: Once this place fed jump orders to fleets; now it is a hollowed-out skeleton buzzing on backup power, perfect for tucking away something that listens to the lanes without anyone officially admitting it exists. Buried in the old war-room circuitry, whatever has been humming along with modern traffic is still wired into forgotten UC relays and ghost beacons, quietly pulling patterns that point back to one man. The Grim Cohort holds the interior like they are guarding a bad conscience, and every story about why they are here contradicts the last. So far all anyone agrees on is that a wrecked freighter carried math it should not have had, and a retired command node has been whispering the same signature ever since.
zh: 这里曾经向舰队下达跃迁指令；如今它只剩一副被掏空的骨架，靠备用电力嗡鸣，恰好适合藏起某个监听航道、却没有任何官方承认其存在的东西。埋在那套旧作战室电路里的东西——无论是什么一直在与现代交通一同嗡鸣——仍接在被人遗忘的联殖中继与幽灵信标上，悄悄拉出那些指回一个人的模式。冷酷大队把守着内部，像在守卫一份不安的良心，而关于他们为何在此的每一种说法都与上一种矛盾。目前为止，所有人唯一认同的是：一艘损毁的货船携带着它本不该有的数学，而一个退役的指挥节点从此一直在低语着同一个签名。

#en: The relay squats in the dark like a memory everyone swears has faded, yet its antennae still rake the void for whispers no one admits are there. This is where the old diagnostics kept running after the technicians went home, where someone quietly spliced new code into forgotten UC routines and taught them to listen for patterns the official charts refuse to acknowledge. The gang camped here treats the place like just another salvage pit, but their guns say someone paid them to keep curious hands off the archives. So far the trail has been stolen sensor blocks, nervous testimony from a buried UC posting, and a growing realization that the same anomalies keep surfacing where the paperwork insists nothing is wrong.
zh: 那座中继蹲在黑暗中，像一段所有人都发誓已经褪色的记忆，可它的天线仍在扫过虚空，搜寻没人承认存在的低语。这里正是旧诊断程序在技师们回家后仍继续运行的地方，也是有人悄悄把新代码接进被遗忘的联殖程序、教会它们去聆听官方星图拒不承认的模式的地方。扎营于此的帮派把这地方当成又一个打捞坑，可他们的枪口说明，有人付了钱让他们别让好奇的手碰那些档案。目前为止，这条线索是被盗的传感器模块、某座被埋的联殖驻地传出的紧张证词，以及一种越来越清晰的认识：同样的异常不断出现在文书坚称一切正常的地方。

#en: If there is any place where unauthorized power work can go unnoticed, it is Gagarin Landing, with its half-abandoned plants and rusting conduits humming under cheap repairs. Buried in that tangle is the routing pattern that ties Vector's jump anomalies to real infrastructure, the kind of map only a former inspector or a very patient saboteur could assemble. Someone in UC coveralls clearly started to trace it, left half-finished annotations in the dust, and then simply stopped showing up for their shift. So far, the trail runs from a quiet cache on a backworld, through a gutted relay in orbit, into redacted oversight logs and a pattern of improvised power work that always bends toward the same uncharted coordinates.
zh: 若说有什么地方能让未经许可的电力工程不被注意，那就是加加林着陆点——半废弃的厂房、在廉价修补下嗡鸣的锈蚀导管。埋在那团乱麻里的，是那张把"向量"的跃迁异常系到真实基础设施上的线路图，只有前检查员或极有耐心的破坏者才拼得出来的那种地图。显然有个穿联殖工装的人开始追查它，在尘土里留下半途而废的批注，然后就再没来上过班。目前为止，线索从一穷乡星上安静的储藏点，穿过轨道上一座被掏空的中继，进入被涂黑的监督日志与一种临时拼凑的电力工程模式——它总是弯向同一批未标绘的坐标。

#en: The lower decks of Neon are where the city's power bleeds and its memories are scrubbed, which makes them perfect for hiding a record of paths no traffic controller will admit exist. Down here, runoff from the grid pools in forgotten channels, and only the people who live in permanent shadow can trace which conduits are official and which feed quiet side doors for salvagers who never pay docking fees. Somewhere in this dripping maze is the pattern that links anonymous jump entries to unmarked tows, a pattern first hinted at by a stray dataslate on a dead rock and half-erased manifests in a forgotten freight lot, then whispered again in the numbers behind a lonely memorial where settlers' names outnumber their ships.
zh: 霓虹城的下层甲板，是这座城市的电力渗漏、记忆被擦净的地方，这让它们成了藏起一份"任何交通调度员都不会承认存在的路径"记录的绝佳之处。在这下面，电网的溢流积在被遗忘的沟槽里，只有常年生活在阴影中的人才能分辨哪些导管是官方的、哪些通向打捞者悄悄进出的侧门——那些从不付停泊费的打捞者。在这座滴水的迷宫里某处，藏着那个把匿名跃迁条目与未标记拖运联系起来的模式；它最初由死寂岩石上一块散落数据板和废弃货运场里半擦除的舱单暗示，之后又在一座孤独纪念碑背后的数字里被低语重述——那里的定居者名字比他们的船只还多。

#en: Out here, on a nameless stretch of dirt far from the lanes, the air is thin and the sky is clean enough that no one bothers to look up when something goes wrong. That is exactly why he would test things here, where a bad harvest or a failing purifier can be shrugged off as frontier luck instead of design. Whatever is in these drums and soil reports will show whether the collapses were natural or tuned, whether his numbers have been walking ahead of the failures or pushing them. So far the trail is unsettlingly straight: a forgotten survey cache in the backcountry, an orbital log that did not match its own debris field, and corporate schedules that always seemed to tighten around the same kinds of fragile settlements.
zh: 在这里、在一段远离航道的无名土地上，空气稀薄，天空清朗到出了事也没人会抬头看。这正是他会在这种地方做试验的原因——在这里，一场歉收或一台损坏的净化器都能被当成边境的运气、而非设计，耸耸肩了事。这些桶里和土壤报告里的东西，会显示那些崩坏是自然的还是被调好的，他的数字是在那些失败之前先行、还是在推着它们走。目前为止，这条线索直得令人不安：偏远乡间一处被遗忘的勘探储藏点、一份与自身碎片场对不上的轨道日志，以及总是似乎围绕同样那些脆弱定居点收紧的公司日程。

#en: The abandoned UC listening post still hums with half-asleep systems, walls lined with scrubbed logs and redacted manifests that never made it back to central review. This is where quiet corrections were filed, where people learned that speaking plainly about missing ships and wrong jump angles could end a career, or worse. Whatever ledger was kept off the books here is one of the few places his edits and official silence overlap; without it, the pattern stays rumor.  \n\nSo far the trail has given you a stray datapad in backcountry rock and a buried monitoring station full of censored telemetry, each hinting that the same hand has been bending charts while everyone with clearance learned to talk around what they saw.
zh: 那座废弃的联殖听音哨仍带着半睡半醒的系统嗡鸣，墙上排着被擦净的日志与从未送回中枢复核的涂黑舱单。这里正是安静修正被归档的地方，是人们学到"把失踪船只和错误跃迁角度说清楚可能会毁掉前程、甚至更糟"的地方。此处账外留存的那本账，正是少数几个他的编辑与官方沉默重叠的地方之一；没有它，这个模式就仍是传闻。  \n\n目前为止，这条线索给了你一块落在乡间岩石上的散落数据板，以及一座塞满被审查遥测的被埋监测站，每一处都暗示同一只手一直在掰弯星图，而每一个有权限的人都学会了绕着他们所见的东西说话。

#en: Out here, between grav wells and patrol grids, is where someone like her would hang a listening post and never give it a name. The little beacon riding this orbit is doing more than navigation; its pulse is folded with routing updates, timing cues, and quiet course corrections that only make sense if you already know the pattern. Whatever coordinates she trusts enough to use repeatedly will be buried in those intervals, tucked between the numbers everyone pretends not to see. So far the trail runs from that empty frontier homestead, to the corrupted telemetry near its sky, to lab notes and substrate tests pointing at the same deep-space anomaly, each clue suggesting her next jump is charted just beyond official maps.
zh: 在这里、在引力井与巡逻网格之间，某个人会把她那样的听音哨挂在这里，且从不给它起名字。骑着这条轨道的小信标做的不只是导航；它的脉冲里折着航线更新、计时提示与安静的航向修正——只有在你已经知道那个模式时，它们才说得通。她信任到反复使用的任何坐标，都会埋进那些间隔里，夹在所有人都假装没看见的数字之间。目前为止，线索从那座空荡的边境农场，延伸到它天空中那处损坏的遥测，再到指向同一处深空异常的实验笔记与基底试验，每一条线索都暗示：她的下一次跃迁，已绘制在官方星图之外不远处。

#en: Ryujin's tower is where numbers stop being abstract and start deciding who gets to exist. If anyone is quietly tunneling through corporate ledgers and faction warrants, there will be fingerprints buried in the interfaces that supervise payrolls, benefits, and write-offs for half of Neon. The stories drifting through Ebbside say some quiet auditor out there can flip a foreclosure or vanish a bounty from behind a public terminal, and every retelling insists the access starts here, under glossy conference rooms and sanctioned data vaults. So far, the trail is a scratched dataslate on a backwater rock, a corrupted traffic beacon in orbit, and a derelict SysDef hull whose cargo logs rewrote themselves while the crew slept.
zh: 龙神大楼，就是那些数字不再抽象、而开始决定谁能存在的地方。若有人在悄悄钻穿公司的账册与派系令状，那在监督霓虹城半数薪水、福利与注销事务的界面里，一定埋着指纹。在埃布赛德流传的故事说，外面有个安静的审计员能从一台公共终端后面翻转一宗止赎、或让一笔赏金凭空消失，而每一次重述都坚称，入口就在这里——在光鲜的会议室与获批的数据金库之下。目前为止，这条线索是穷乡岩石上一块被划花的数据板、轨道上一座损坏的交通信标，以及一具废弃的星防队船壳——它的货运日志在船员睡觉时自己改写了。

#en: Out in high orbit, far from traffic lanes, the old recon grid still listens to nothing and remembers everything. This is where path and pattern can be separated from rumor, where the sky itself keeps a ledger no clerk can quietly amend. The sensor buoys hang in silence, but their last recorded vectors will show which shadowed corridor a salvager chose when he slipped through restricted airspace, and who helped him pass unseen.  \n\nSo far the trail runs from a quiet cache on a forgotten rock to nervous half-truths in a backroom bar, then to a relay bunker where logs did not quite match the official story, and every time the subject edges close to certain derelicts, the people who were there stop meeting anyone's eyes.
zh: 在高轨道上、远离航道之处，那片旧侦察网仍在什么也听不到、却什么都记得。这里正是能把路径与模式从传闻中分离出来的地方，是天空本身保存着一本没有文书能悄悄修改的账簿的地方。传感器浮标静默地悬着，但它们最后记录的向量会显示：当某名打捞者溜过受限空域时，选了哪条阴影走廊，又是谁帮他无声通过。  \n\n目前为止，线索从被遗忘岩石上一处安静的储藏点，延伸到密室酒吧里紧张的半真半假，再到一座日志与官方说法对不太上的中继掩体；而每一次话题一逼近某些特定的弃船，曾在场的人就再也不与任何人对上目光。

#en: Down here beneath the gridwork and rain-streaked neon, the city's forgotten supports carry more than power; they carry secrets no one ever bothered to log. This is where back-channel brokers sketch their own version of the Settled Systems, marking which corridors are safe, which docks are watched, which names carry quiet protection. A single misdrawn line, a misheard registry digit, can strand a hauler in the wrong orbit or send a debtor straight into the arms of someone like Luc, and no one corrects the chart afterward. So far the trail is a lost dataslate on a backwater rock, cargo anomalies around Gagarin's loading bays, and whispers that the same unseen hand is redrawing routes for people as easily as for freight.
zh: 在这下面、在网格与雨痕斑驳的霓虹之下，这座城市被遗忘的支柱承载的不只是电力；它们还承载着没人费心记录的机密。这里正是暗渠掮客勾勒他们自己那版"定居星系"的地方：标出哪些走廊安全、哪些船坞被盯梢、哪些名字带着无声的保护。一条画错的线、一位听错的登记号，就能让一艘货船困在错误的轨道上，或把一个欠债人径直送进像吕克那样的人怀里，而事后没人去修正那张图。目前为止，线索是穷乡岩石上一块丢失的数据板、加加林星装货湾附近的货物异常，以及关于同一只隐形之手像改写货运一样轻易地改写人生航线的低语。

#en: Trade Authority hulls are supposed to be forgettable, moving other people's secrets on predictable lanes, but Deepwater TR-9346 hangs dead in the dark like a confession someone tried to erase. Whatever was worth killing the lights out here was important enough that crews in distant ports only mutter about it over half-finished drinks, afraid the wrong ears are always listening. If Rourke and Vector wanted a record of where they vanish between systems, this is where they would hide it, behind manifests and routing codes only smugglers and accountants understand. So far the trail runs from that isolated homestead to strange orbital telemetry, each whisper tying their movements to off-the-books cargo and vanished convoys.
zh: 贸易管理局的船壳本该是让人过目即忘的，在可预测的航道上运送别人的秘密，可"深水 TR-9346"死寂地悬在黑暗中，像一份有人试图抹掉的忏悔。无论是什么值得把这里的灯光都掐灭，它都重要到让远方港市的船员只敢在喝剩半杯时低声议论，唯恐总有错误的耳朵在听。如果鲁尔克和"向量"想要一份记录，记下他们在星系之间消失于何处，这里就是他们会藏它的地方——藏在只有走私者和会计才看得懂的舱单与航线代码之后。目前为止，线索从那座与世隔绝的农场延伸到古怪的轨道遥测，每一句低语都把他们的行踪与账外货物和消失的车队系在一起。

#en: Gagarin Landing is where the ground still remembers steel; pipe runs and service conduits here once tied directly into the same freight flow that fed the graveyard he haunts. Buried in these rusting backlines is the one piece of routing work he could not do alone, a quiet splice left for a partner who never came back to finish the job. If that forgotten connection still exists, it will translate local chatter and yard schedules into a path that mirrors his private drift between derelicts. So far, the trail runs from a lost dataslate on a nowhere rock, through a stripped Deimos lot and a silent relay bunker, each step peeling away the lie of random chance and exposing a deliberate orbit around old wrecks and older guilt.
zh: 加加林着陆点，就是大地仍记得钢铁的地方；这里的管线与服务导管曾经直接接入同一股货运流——正是喂养他所出没的那片墓地的那股流。在这些锈蚀的后线里，埋着一件他一个人做不成的线路工程：一处安静的接驳，留给了一个再没回来完工的伙伴。若那条被遗忘的连接仍然存在，它会把本地闲谈与船坞日程翻译成一条路径，一条映照他在弃船之间私人漂移的路径。目前为止，线索从一块鸟不拉屎岩石上丢失的数据板，穿过火卫二一片被剥光的场区与一座沉默的中继掩体，每一步都剥掉"随机巧合"的谎言，露出一个围绕旧残骸与更旧罪疚的刻意轨道。

#en: Down in Neon's underbelly, the air tastes like rust and Aurora bleed-off, and every corridor angles just enough to make you feel watched. If anyone is massaging risk for a living, their records will be buried where the house rigs every game and the losers keep coming back anyway. Here, nav-sellers and data snakes whisper over cheap drinks about routes that never make it onto official charts, and the same three-branched patterns keep surfacing in side-channel chatter before being laughed off in public. Back in Gagarin the captains only muttered about a ghost planner and strangely familiar corridors; now the numbers, the rumors of GalBank losses, and the quiet respect paid to a certain ex-navigator are starting to line up.
zh: 在霓虹城的下腹，空气尝起来像铁锈与极光渗漏，每条走廊都恰好拐出一点角度，让你觉得有人在看。若有人靠揉捏风险为生，他的记录就会被埋在赌场操纵每一场赌局、而输家却照样一次次回来的地方。在这里，导航贩子和数据蛇在廉价酒水上低声谈论从不上官方星图的航线，而同样的三岔模式不断在侧信道闲谈里浮现，然后被公开场合一笑带过。在加加林星，船长们此前只是嘟囔着一个幽灵规划者和似曾相识的走廊；如今，那些数字、关于盖尔银行亏空的传闻，以及人们对某位前领航员那份安静的敬意，开始对上了。

#en: This orbiting cache exists precisely because someone meant to clean it up and never came back; a freight ghost hanging off the lane, wrapped in a hull scarred by old burns and the lazy patrol patterns of the Specterborn. Log buffers are full, message queues jammed, manifests half-updated then abandoned, as if a clerk somewhere assumed a cleaner hand would sweep the data into silence. Instead it drifts, preserving a perfect record of where one particular hauler slipped off official routes and down toward quieter soil. So far the trail runs from a forgotten groundside cache to a dead archive in an abandoned lab, to retrofit notes in a dusty shipyard, each step tightening the circle around a single name everyone avoids saying.
zh: 这座轨道储藏点之所以存在，恰恰是因为有人打算清理它、却再没回来；一个挂在航道外的货运幽灵，裹在一具被旧烧伤与"幽魂生"懒散巡逻队形留下的伤疤所覆盖的船壳里。日志缓冲区满了，消息队列堵了，舱单更新到一半就被弃置，仿佛某处的文书以为会有更干净的手把这些数据扫入沉默。可它只是漂着，完美保存着某一艘货船偏离官方航线、滑向更安静土壤的记录。目前为止，线索从地面上一处被遗忘的储藏点，到一座废弃实验室里死掉的档案库，再到积灰船坞里的改装笔记，每一步都收紧着围绕一个所有人都不愿提起的名字的圆圈。

#en: Out here, away from patrol routes and station traffic, an Aegis agent chose to die with their back to bare rock and their notes locked behind personal encryption. Whatever they wrote, they wrote where no one could overhear, which means it cuts too close to the kind of truth that gets edited in committee rooms. The terrain is nothing, the air thin, the silence heavy, but that is exactly why the trail passes through this spot.  \n\nSo far I have a dead cache on a nameless world, a broken recorder in orbit, and whispers from New Atlantis about redacted audits and missing test crews; each piece feels straightforward on its own, yet together they keep slipping sideways every time I try to draw a clean line through Vector's path.
zh: 在这里、远离巡逻航线与星际站交通之处，一名宙斯盾特工选择背靠赤裸岩石死去，把笔记锁在个人加密之后。无论他们写了什么，他们都是在没人能偷听到的地方写的——这意味着它离那种会在委员会房间里被编辑的真相太近了。地形一片虚无，空气稀薄，沉默沉重，但这正是这条线索要经过此点的原因。  \n\n目前为止，我有一颗无名世界上的死掉储藏点、轨道上一台损坏的记录仪，以及来自新亚特兰蒂斯城的低语——关于涂黑的审计与失踪的试验组；每一块单独看都很直白，可一旦我试图为"向量"的路径画出一条干净的线，它们合在一起就总是往旁边溜。

#en: The scout hangs adrift in the dark like a redacted line in a report, its UC markings scoured by time and panic. Whatever passed through its nav-core was important enough for someone to let a Vanguard asset vanish rather than admit what it had seen. Inside, frozen telemetry and half-burned logs still remember the routes it was ordered to fly, the patterns someone tried to erase, the sketch of a grid that should not exist. If any record survived the purge, it will be here, between cold steel and dead consoles. So far, all we have is a scavenged dataslate from the fringe and fuel tallies that do not match declared flight plans, both pointing to hidden corridors in the lanes that captains whisper about but never quite agree on.
zh: 那艘侦察船在黑暗中漂泊，像报告里一行被涂黑的字，它身上的联殖标识被时间与恐慌磨蚀。凡是经过它导航核心的东西，都重要到有人宁可让一件先锋队资产消失，也不肯承认它看见了什么。里面冻结的遥测与半烧毁的日志，仍记得它奉命飞过的航线、有人试图抹掉的模式，以及一张本不该存在的网格草图。若说还有任何记录在清理中存活，它就在这里——在冰冷的钢铁与死掉的控制台之间。目前为止，我们只有一块从边境拾来的数据板，以及与申报飞行计划对不上的燃料统计，两者都指向航道中那些船长们低声议论、却从来对不上口径的隐藏走廊。

#en: The smell of coolant and burnt sealant hangs low in the maintenance bay, a permanent haze that makes every breath feel a little compromised, a little negotiated. Whoever keeps engines running here also keeps the local air monitors talking to the wrong people, and the crew that calls this place home looks just nervous enough to know it. The story is always the same: no one has heard of him, no one touches atmospheric firmware, everyone minds their own business while systems quietly rewrite themselves. From the forgotten outpost to the courier that vanished from its route, the pattern so far has been thin comfort layered over quiet sabotage, and this is the first place where fear and convenience finally share the same toolbox.
zh: 冷却液与烧焦密封胶的味道低低地悬在维修舱里，一层永久的雾气，让每一次呼吸都像打了点折扣、做了点交易。凡是让这里引擎不停的人，也让本地空气监测仪对错误的人说话；而把这个地方称作家的船员，看起来紧张得恰到好处，说明他们知道这一点。故事永远一样：没人听说过他，没人碰大气固件，人人只管自己的事，而系统悄悄改写着自己。从那座被遗忘的前哨，到那艘从航线上消失的信使船，目前为止的模式一直是薄薄一层安慰盖在安静的破坏之上，而这里是恐惧与便利第一次共用同一只工具箱的地方。

#en: RS-8275 Riftblade hangs in the dark like it died mid-thought, running lights off, systems idling just enough to keep the cold from chewing through the hull. If there is anywhere the story might be written plainly, it is on a ship like this, far from auditors and angry clients, its logs untouched since the last jump went wrong. Whatever record is tucked into its systems should be just numbers and routes, nothing mystical about it, yet everyone who mentioned this vessel spoke in careful hedges and changed the subject fast. So far the trail is thin but persistent: a datapad in the dust, jittering readings from a lonely monitoring shack, now a nameless hauler with drive history that does not quite match the story its owners told.
zh: RS-8275 裂隙之刃悬在黑暗中，像在思考到一半时死去：航行灯关闭，系统怠速到刚好不让寒冷咬穿船壳。若说这故事有哪里可能被平白地写下来，那就是这样一艘船上——远离审计员与愤怒的客户，自最后一次跃迁出错后日志再未被触碰。塞进它系统里的记录本该只是些数字与航线，毫无神秘可言，可每一个提起这艘船的人都措辞谨慎、迅速换个话题。目前为止，这条线索稀薄却执着：尘土里一块数据板、一座孤零零监控棚里抖动的读数，如今又是一艘无名的货船——它的引擎履历与船主讲的故事对不太上。

#en: The old relay bunker sits just outside the sweep of current patrol grids, a rusting nerve ending from a war everyone pretends is over. Its dishes still point at empty sky, listening, storing echoes in systems no one bothered to fully shut down. This is where a lone tech pulled atmospheric traces that did not match any registered flight plan, then walked away from their post and never raised their voice about it again. The data they stole is the only honest witness left. So far the trail runs like this: a buried dataslate in the frontier, careful half-truths in a Neon tower, then a SysDef hull adrift with logs that all agree on one thing, if nothing else the same signature keeps slipping through airspace that should be locked.
zh: 那座旧中继掩体恰好坐落在现行巡逻网格的扫描范围之外，一场所有人都假装已经结束的战争留下的一截锈蚀神经末梢。它的天线盘仍指向空荡的天空，聆听着，把回声存进没人费心彻底关掉的系统里。这里正是某名孤独技师拉出那些与任何登记飞行计划都对不上大气痕迹的地方，之后他离开岗位，再没为此出过一次声。他偷走的数据，是仅存的诚实证人。目前为止，线索是这样的：边境一块被埋的数据板、霓虹城某座塔里谨慎的半真半假，然后是一具漂泊的星防队船壳——它的日志至少有一点是一致的：同一个签名不断溜过本该被锁死的空域。

#en: The outpost is quiet in the way only abandoned military hardware can be, all dead screens and half-heard echoes in the ducting, but the lines are still listening. Buried in its cold racks are route corrections and signal ghosts no one ever meant to file, the kind of numbers you only keep when you want to bend traffic without leaving fingerprints. Whoever paid the Gutter Deadwater crew to squat here understands that; they are not guarding rubble, they are guarding a story that cannot stand daylight.  \n\nSo far the trail runs from a stray dataslate on a forgotten rock to hushed boasts in backroom bars about ships that left port on one course and arrived along another, with a pilot no one names steering those quiet corrections.
zh: 那座前哨静得只有被遗弃的军用硬件才静得出来：全是死掉的屏幕与通风管里听不真切的回声，可那些线路仍在聆听。埋在它冰冷机架里的，是无人打算归档的航线修正与信号幽灵——那种只有想在不留指纹的情况下掰弯交通时，你才会留下的数字。付钱让"阴沟死水"那帮人蹲守于此的人明白这一点；他们守的不是瓦砾，而是一个见不得光的故事。  \n\n目前为止，线索从被遗忘岩石上一块散落数据板，延伸到密室酒吧里压低声音的吹嘘——关于船只从某个港口以一种航向出港、却沿另一种航向抵达，而一名没人点名提起的飞行员在操纵着那些安静的修正。

#en: It hangs in the dark just off the main traffic spine, a sliver of metal and code sitting where no registered beacon should be, yet close enough that every drifting hauler brushes its gravity well of bad advice. This is where the invisible hand on the lanes does its work, nudging convoys a fraction of a degree toward empty space or waiting guns, and the battered hull of the SL-6956 Dustshank circling it says someone has been profiting off that adjustment for a long time while everyone else looked the other way. So far the trail runs from a forgotten surface shack with wiped consoles and strange waypoint names to a dead lifeboat looped in panic, and every scrap of data points back to the same quiet reshaping of Narion's routes.
zh: 它悬在黑暗中，就在主交通主轴外侧，一片金属与代码的碎片，坐落在任何已登记信标都不该在的位置，却又近到每一艘漂过的货船都会蹭上它那个"坏建议"的引力井。这里正是航道上的隐形之手干活的地方——把车队朝空荡太空或等候的枪口推偏零点几度；而绕着它转的那具"SL-6956 尘胫"破旧船壳则说明，有人长期从这种调整里获利，而其他所有人都转开了视线。目前为止，线索从一座控制台被擦净、航点名字古怪的被遗忘地面小屋，延伸到一艘在恐慌中打转的死掉救生艇，而每一点数据都指回同一件事：纳里昂星航线的安静重塑。

#en: Out here the Deserted Relay Station is more than scrap; it is the last intact nerve in a network she has been carving up for years, the only place she can stand at the center of every blackout and pull the plug on whole systems at once. Its old UC hardware still ties cleanly into buried trunk lines, letting her flood the dark with one final burst of doctored truth or burn the raw records before anyone else can see them. Someone in uniform tried to erase those records long ago, but redacted logs, drifting cargo hulks, and hushed bar stories kept the shape of them alive; a dead ship with sabotaged relays, a frontier farm that went silent at the worst possible moment, and a trail of payments to outposts no one wanted on the books.
zh: 在这里，那座"被遗弃的中继站"不只是废铁；它是她多年来一直在切割的那张网里最后一根完好无损的神经，是她唯一能站在每一场断网中心、一次性掐断整套系统的地方。它那套旧联殖硬件仍干净地接在被埋的主干线上，让她能把改过手脚的真相以最后一次脉冲灌满黑暗，或在别人看到之前烧掉原始记录。很久以前有个穿军装的人试图抹掉那些记录，但涂黑的日志、漂着的货船残骸与压低声音的酒吧故事让它们的形状活了下来：一艘中继被破坏的死船、一座在最糟糕的时刻陷入沉默的边境农场，以及一串付给那些没人愿意记入账册的外站的款项。

#en: Down here the city's glow turns to a damp, electric haze, and every rusted mech frame and jury-rigged servo hums with stolen power. If Vector wanted to hide his numbers inside hardware, this is where the trail would surface: in off-the-books repair jobs, "upgrades" that quietly rewrite flight logic, and half-remembered sightings of a ghost technician tweaking guidance cores for drink money. The only way to separate rumor from math is to strip these machines back to their bare vectors and see whose hand tuned them. So far I have a forgotten dataslate on a backworld, a crooked orbital buoy, and freight captains in Gagarin who insist their ships turned away from something in the dark that no official log will admit was ever there.
zh: 在这下面，城市的辉光变成一层潮湿的电气雾霭，每一具锈蚀的机甲框架与勉强拼凑的伺服都在因偷来的电力嗡鸣。若"向量"想把他的数字藏进硬件里，线索就会在这里浮出：在账外维修活儿里、在悄悄改写飞行逻辑的"升级"里，以及在半模糊的记忆中对一名为酒钱调校制导核心的幽灵技师的目击。把传闻与数学分开的唯一办法，就是把这些机器剥回到赤裸的向量，看看是谁的手调校了它们。目前为止，我有一穷乡星上被遗忘的数据板、一座歪斜的轨道浮标，以及加加林星上那些坚称自己的船在黑暗中避开了某个官方日志绝不承认存在之物的货船船长。

#en: Behind the glass and chrome of Ryujin's tower, the real memories are kept in air-gapped corners and mislabeled archives, where no quarterly report ever reaches. If anyone in Neon has a record of which ships vanished on impossible shortcuts and which executives signed off on those quiet contracts, it is buried in this building's forgotten copies, not out in any spacer bar. To follow the trail further, the paper ghosts have to be forced into the light. So far all I have are fragments: a stray dataslate in the back country, nervous denials in a corporate office, and a cutter's corrupted logs that all point to the same kind of route, the same missing name, and a pattern of "oversights" that feels too deliberate to be simple neglect.
zh: 在龙神大楼的玻璃与铬合金之后，真正的记忆被保存在物理隔离的角落与标签错乱的档案库里，那里是任何季度报告都到不了的地方。若霓虹城里有谁记录着哪些船在不可能的捷径上消失、哪些高管签过那些安静的合同，那它就埋在这栋楼被遗忘的副本里，而不在任何太空劫匪的酒吧里。要把这条线索追下去，这些纸上的幽灵必须被逼到光下。目前为止我只有碎片：乡间一块散落数据板、某间公司办公室里紧张的否认，以及一艘切割船损坏的日志——它们都指向同一种航线、同一个失踪的名字，以及一种"疏忽"的模式，感觉太过刻意，不像是单纯的不上心。

#en: The farm looks harmless from orbit, just another patch of soil and machinery clinging to a thin margin in Freestar space, but the traffic patterns tell a different story. Haulers that never show on public ledgers keep dropping in after dark, and local talk drops to a murmur whenever someone mentions certain cargo manifests. Whatever path the salvager is carving through war wrecks and abandoned yards, the records tying it together were hidden where nobody expects more than grain and root vegetables. So far, all anyone will admit is this: a stray slate out in the black mentioned a missing tug, that tug's markings turned up on scrap buried in a field, and every whisper since has circled the same shipbreaker's name in hushed voices.
zh: 这座农场从轨道上看人畜无害，不过是自由星系联盟星域边缘又一片依附着薄薄一隅的土壤与机械，可交通模式讲的却是另一回事。从不出现在公开账册上的货船不断在入夜后降落，只要有人提起某些货物舱单，本地的谈话就会低成一片呢喃。无论那名打捞者在战争残骸与废弃场区之间刻出的是一条什么路径，把它们串起来的记录，都被藏在了没人指望除了谷物和根茎蔬菜之外还有别的东西的地方。目前为止，所有人愿意承认的只有这些：漆黑太空中一块散落数据板提到一艘失踪的拖船，那艘拖船的标记出现在田里埋着的废料上，而此后每一句低语，都用压低的声音绕着同一个拆船人的名字打转。

#en: Out on the moon's dark side, the cargo relay hangs just far enough from the lanes that nobody asks why manifests never quite match the traffic. This is where hearsay hardens into evidence, where a fence who swears he only moves scrap just happens to handle the same sealed containers that keep turning up in frontier crises. Every dockhand here has a different version of the story about a quiet Scotsman routing lifelines and ghosts through unlogged bays, the tale growing taller each time it changes mouths. So far, all you have are a lost dataslate, an overfed harvest that should have failed, and a ledger from a dead farm that sketched a hidden spine through the Settled Systems, every segment marked with his patient, practiced hand.
zh: 在卫星阴暗的那一面，那座货运中继悬得离航道刚好足够远，没人会追问为什么舱单总与交通对不上。这里正是道听途说硬化成证据的地方，一个发誓只倒卖废料的销赃商，偏偏经手的正是那些不断出现在边境危机中的同款密封货柜。这里的每个码头工都有一套不同的版本，讲一个沉默的苏格兰人如何把生命线与幽灵送过未登记的货舱，故事每换一张嘴就长高一分。目前为止，你只有一块丢失的数据板、一场本该失败却产量过剩的收成，以及一份来自死掉农场的账册——它勾勒出一条穿越定居星系的隐藏脊柱，每一段都标着他那种耐心而熟练的手笔。

#en: Gagarin Landing is where the numbers stopped adding up and nobody bothered to ask why. Old tug parts, refitted grav-drives, and forgotten cargo records all passed through here, each slightly mistranscribed, mistimed, or misfiled until the errors formed a corridor only one pilot knew how to read. Whatever is hidden among these refurbished hulls and corporate refurb shops is the translation key that turns those scattered mistakes into a deliberate route, the next bend in her invisible lane. So far the trail is stitched from chance and oversight: a mislaid dataslate in the back of beyond, incomplete logs from a quiet lab, and a relay that repeated the wrong traffic just long enough for someone like her to disappear between the lines.
zh: 加加林着陆点，就是那些数字不再对得上、而没人费心问为什么的地方。旧拖船零件、改装的引力引擎与被遗忘的货运记录都从这里经过，每一件都被轻微地误抄、误时或错误归档，直到这些错误形成了一条只有一名飞行员才懂得如何阅读的走廊。藏在这些翻新船壳与公司翻新铺子之间的东西，就是那把把零散错误译成刻意航线的钥匙，是她那条隐形航道上的下一个弯。目前为止，这条线索是由偶然与疏忽缝成的：天涯之外一块放错位置的数据板、一座安静实验室里残缺的日志，以及一座把错误交通重复到刚好足够她那样的人消失在字里行间的时长。

#en: The asteroid field is the only place this fragment could survive unnoticed, tucked between dead rock and background noise, its signal warped by drifting stone and old collision scars. Whoever seeded it here understood Grav Drive telemetry and how to hide a map inside the static, counting on distance and radiation to erase the last trace of a forbidden pattern. But stone shifts, sensors grow sharper, and whispers about a missing pilot and a lost experiment have pulled too many eyes toward these broken orbits to ignore. So far the trail runs like this scattered data in a forgotten system, a hushed exchange above a quiet colony, and the growing suspicion that all those grav spikes and redacted logs are pieces of one long erased jump.
zh: 这片小行星带，是这块碎片唯一能在无人注意中存活的地方：夹在死岩石与背景噪声之间，信号被漂移的石块与旧碰撞伤疤扭歪。把它播在这里的人懂引力引擎遥测，也懂得如何把地图藏进静电里，指望距离与辐射抹掉一个被禁模式的最后痕迹。可石头会移动，传感器会变敏锐，而关于一名失踪飞行员与一次丢失实验的低语，已经把这些破碎轨道拉进了太多无法忽视的视线。目前为止，这条线索是这样的：某个被遗忘星系里的零散数据、某座安静殖民地上空压低声音的交谈，以及一种越来越强的怀疑——所有那些引力尖峰与涂黑日志，都是一次早已被抹除的长跃迁的碎片。

#en: Out here the orbit is wrong in ways the charts do not admit, a thin ring of wrecks and cold buoys bent around a single, precise disturbance in the dark. Whatever she has been testing, this is where the pattern tightens, where a harmless calibration rig became the quiet heart of a new lane that threads between patrols and trade alike. Left alone, it settles into routine, just another invisible shortcut baked into the habits of smugglers and frightened settlers until no one remembers who first drew it. The trail so far runs from a cramped Freestar trailer stacked with nervous Ranger notes to a scarred sensor buoy replaying the convoy's last seconds, each record showing her math slowly migrating from sanctioned grids into the shadows.
zh: 在这里，这条轨道以星图不肯承认的方式出了错：一圈由残骸与冰冷浮标构成的细环，弯折于黑暗中一处孤零零而精确的扰动周围。无论她一直在测试什么，这里正是模式收得最紧的地方——一台无害的校准设备成了某条新航道的安静心脏，那条航道穿行于巡逻队与贸易船之间。任其自生自灭，它就会沉淀为例行惯例，成为又一则隐形捷径，被烤进走私者与惊惶定居者的习惯里，直到没人记得是谁先画下它。目前为止，线索从一辆塞满游骑兵紧张笔记的拥挤自由星系联盟拖车，延伸到一枚反复重放车队最后几秒的伤痕累累的传感器浮标，每一份记录都显示她的数学正慢慢从获批的网格迁入阴影。

#en: Out here in the dark, where a GalBank protection ship drifts without escort or explanation, numbers mean more than guns; this is where the quiet decisions that starved or saved whole colonies were recorded before someone tried to erase them by losing the entire vault to deep orbit. The GA-2267 Securehaul was never meant to be a tomb, just a moving firewall between investors and risk, but a slow accretion of pressure, audits, and off-the-books riders turned it into the only place the unedited story still lives. Back in the factories and docks you found scorched manifests and uneasy inspectors in Gagarin, each hinting that freight routes, loan terms, and crop failures were not accidents but the first visible seams in a larger design.
zh: 在这片黑暗里，一艘盖尔银行护航船无护航、无解释地漂着，在这里数字比枪炮更有分量；正是在这里，那些饿死或救活整片殖民地的安静决定被记录了下来，之后才有人试图通过把整座金库丢进深空来抹掉它们。"GA-2267 安全运输"从来不该是一座坟墓，只是投资者与风险之间一道移动的防火墙，可压力、审计与账外附加条款的缓慢积累，把它变成了未删改故事唯一还活着的地方。回到工厂与码头，你在加加林星发现了烧焦的舱单与不安的检查员，每一处都暗示：货运航线、贷款条款与作物歉收都不是意外，而是一场更大设计中最初可见的裂缝。

#en: Out here, suspended between a dead black sky and the thin glow of another struggling world, nobody can look away or pretend not to see the pattern.  \nOnly an orbital trail record can show how often his work brushes past the same colonies, how many times a maintenance shuttle lingers just long enough to rewrite a forecast before vanishing into deep transit lanes.  \nPlanetside, mechanics mutter into their cups and supervisors suddenly find urgent business elsewhere when his name drifts through conversation, but the telemetry does not avert its gaze; from the outpost logs, the courier manifests, and the doctored garage readouts, the same masked flight profile keeps surfacing, tying his movements to every quiet failure on the frontier.
zh: 在这里，悬在死寂的黑色天空与另一颗挣扎世界的微弱辉光之间，没人能移开视线或假装看不见这个模式。  \n只有一份轨道轨迹记录能显示，他的工作在同样的殖民地旁擦过多少次，一艘维护穿梭机又有多少次恰好停留到足以改写一份预报、然后消失进深空运输航道。  \n在地面上，机械师对着杯子嘟囔，而只要他的名字在谈话中飘过，主管们就突然发现别处有急事，可遥测不会移开目光；从前哨日志、信使舱单到被做手脚的车库读数，同一个被遮掩的飞行轮廓不断浮现，把他的行踪与边境上每一次悄无声息的失败系在一起。

#en: This forgotten listening post is where old signals go to be ignored, which is exactly why someone chose it as a dead letterbox. Its orbit is decayed but stable, too cheap to deorbit, too minor to reclaim, so it just hangs here with its dishes half-locked, catching echoes no one is supposed to see. Whoever has been bending the lanes needed a place like this, a station with a reputation for holding on to hardware, logs, and assignments long after the budget said they should be gone. So far, the trail is thin but real: a scorched dataslate in a backwater shed talking about unsafe drones, and now this derelict node, its power draw just a little too high and its receivers pointed a few degrees off where any honest relay would be listening.
zh: 这座被遗忘的听音哨，是旧信号前去被忽视的地方，这正是有人把它选作死信箱的原因。它的轨道已衰减但稳定，脱轨太费钱、回收又太微不足道，所以它就这么挂着，天线盘半锁着，捕捉没人该看到的回声。一直在掰弯航道的那个人需要这样的地方——一座以"在预算说它们该消失之后仍长期保留硬件、日志与任务"而闻名的星际站。目前为止，这条线索稀薄却真实：一座穷乡棚屋里一块烧焦的数据板在谈论不安全的无人机，以及如今这个废弃节点——它的耗电略高了一点点，接收器偏离了任何诚实中继会聆听的方向几度。

#en: This place is where the lines cross, where an old civilian shell fronts for an autonomous plant whose guidance code has been rewritten so many times it hums like a choir of ghosts; if the heart of it keeps beating, more ships will drift into carefully shaped funerals and no one will ever prove why. Word is Outcast Detail are inside, guarding something they swear is just another black job for a faceless handler, and every tech, merc, and clerk who mentions it insists they heard it from someone else first, like the rumor is walking on its own. So far the trail has been a relay that talked after it died, a gutted merc post with doctored beacons, and scattered logs all mapping back toward one engineer who never stopped cleaning up the war.
zh: 这地方正是线条交汇之处：一层旧民用外壳之下，是一座自主工厂，它的制导代码被改写过太多次，嗡鸣得像一支幽灵合唱团；只要它的心脏仍在跳动，就会有更多船只漂进精心塑形的葬礼，而永远没人能证明原因。据说被逐分队就在里面，守着他们发誓只是又一桩替无名雇主干的黑活的东西；每一个提起此事的技师、佣兵和文书都坚称自己是先从别人那里听来的，仿佛这则传闻在自行走路。目前为止，这条线索是一座死后仍在说话的中继、一处带着被做手脚信标的被掏空佣兵据点，以及散落各处的日志——它们全都映射回同一名从未停止清理这场战争的工程师。

#en: Out here the Helium-3 stacks are more than fuel; they are leverage on every ship that dares to jump through this sector, and he has tied the plant's grav regulators into a single twitch of his hand. The towers hum at the edge of harmonic failure, pressure alarms ghosting through the metal like distant thunder, promising that one wrong surge will light the sky and scrub every trace of his work. Cutting him off here means severing his last, dirtiest lane before it ripples across trade routes and warfronts alike. We traced his pattern from a corrupted beacon in the rocks to a Freestar hulk gutted by overstrained drives, each log whispering the same careful handwriting and the same missing seconds nobody in the reports wanted to talk about.
zh: 在这里，那些氦-3 储罐不只是燃料；它们是对每一艘胆敢跃迁穿越这片星域的船只的杠杆，而他已把这座设施的引力调节器系在自己手部的一次抽动上。那些塔在谐波失效的边缘嗡鸣，压力警报像远处闷雷一样在金属里游荡，预示着一次错误的浪涌就会点亮天空、抹掉他工作的每一丝痕迹。在这里切断他，意味着在他最后一条、也是最肮脏的航道扩散到贸易航线与战线之前把它截断。我们追着他的模式从岩石间一座损坏的信标，追到一艘被超负荷引擎掏空内部的自由星系联盟残骸，每一份日志都低语着同样谨慎的笔迹，以及报告里没人愿意谈起的同样几秒空缺。

#en: All the trajectories converge on this tower. Its upper labs once modeled grav behavior for the core worlds, the sort of place Vector audited before the numbers were softened and the warnings buried. Whatever she left behind to point the way will be encoded in work no one outside a handful of specialists even understands, which is exactly why a rogue unit like the Sundered Commandos was sent to lock it down. They argue in low voices about whose orders they are really following, but never loud enough to force a line in the sand. So far the trail shows only fragments: a stray dataslate on a backworld, a gutted satellite in orbit, redacted files pried from a quiet annex, and now a pattern of erased research that all traces back to her hand.
zh: 所有的轨迹都汇聚到这座塔上。它的上层实验室曾为核心世界模拟引力行为，正是"向量"在数字被软化、警告被掩埋之前审计过的那类地方。她留下来指路的东西，会被编码在只有少数专家才看得懂的工作里——这正是像断裂突击队这样一支失控单位被派来封锁它的原因。他们低声争论自己到底在听谁的命令，但从来不够大声，没人敢划下那条线。目前为止，这条线索只有碎片：一穷乡星上一块散落数据板、轨道上一颗被掏空的卫星、从一个安静附属机构撬出来的涂黑文件，以及如今一种被抹除的研究模式——全都追溯回她的手。

#en: Out here, far from any lane that shows on public charts, the beacon hangs alone in the dark, singing corrections into empty space. This is where her work stops pretending to be an accident; every pulse carries a tiny shove, enough to bend traffic away from patrols and toward whatever quiet corridor she favors next. Intercepting that song here, at its source, is the only way to see which horizon she is steering toward before the route hardens into habit and rumor. So far the trail has run from a forgotten outpost, to a faulty orbital transmitter, to a drifting vault ship full of misaligned logs, each step recorded in half-phrases and careful omissions, like everyone hearing the same story but quietly agreeing not to repeat certain parts.
zh: 在这里，远离任何出现在公开星图上的航道，那座信标孤悬于黑暗中，朝空荡太空唱着修正。这里正是她的工作不再假装是意外的地方；每一记脉冲都带着一次微小的推搡，足以把交通掰离巡逻队，转向她下一个中意的安静走廊。在源头处拦截那首歌，是看清她正朝哪片地平线转向的唯一办法——赶在这条航线硬化成习惯与传闻之前。目前为止，线索从一座被遗忘的前哨，到一台故障的轨道发射机，再到一艘塞满错位日志的漂移金库船，每一步都记在半截话与谨慎的省略里，仿佛所有人听着同一个故事，却悄悄约定不重复其中某些部分。

#en: The ground around this quiet settlement still remembers what no one here will describe. Soil meant for crops has been fused and pitted in a rough circle, as if something far heavier than any farm shuttle bled its wake across the homestead and left in a tearing hurry. This is the only place where scorch, strange gravity scars, and a frontier community's sudden silence overlap, where whatever was offloaded or hidden would have brushed against ordinary lives before vanishing back into the lanes. So far the trail is a half erased sensor reading over an empty world, a frightened story told in orbit about a ship that never showed on scopes, and the way every local here talks around the night their sky hummed and nobody was supposed to see it.
zh: 这座安静定居点周围的土地，仍记得这里没人愿意描述的事情。本用于种作物的土壤被熔结、被凿出坑洞，围成一个粗略的圆，仿佛某个远比任何农用穿梭机沉重的东西拖着尾迹划过这片农庄、然后仓皇离去。这是唯一一处灼痕、古怪的引力伤疤与一个边境社群突然的沉默相互重叠的地方——无论当初卸下或藏起的是什么，它都曾擦过平凡的生活，然后消失回航道之中。目前为止，这条线索是一段悬在空荡世界上方被半擦除的传感器读数、一个在轨道上讲起的关于一艘从未出现在示波器上的船的惊恐故事，以及这里每个当地人如何绕着那一晚说话——那晚他们的天空嗡鸣过，而没人该看见它。

#en: It had to be this hulk, drifting where GalBank's clean ledgers cannot follow. The vault-ship is a dead node in Vector's geometry, a place he once trusted to lock away the trajectories that no board wanted on record. Its armored data holds the pattern of every quiet satellite nudge, every storm band moved a fraction off true, and past disputes over flood claims and failed harvests left faint administrative scars in its archives that guided those files here like silt in a current. Back on the fringe station and that abandoned listening post, we saw only corrupted pings and denied payouts; out at the lonely rendezvous in deep space, the trail sharpened into altered beacons and GalBank codes all pointing toward the same unseen hand in orbit.
zh: 必须是这具残骸——漂在盖尔银行干净的账册追不到的地方。那艘金库船是"向量"几何里一个死掉的节点，一处他曾经信任、用来锁住那些没有任何董事会愿意留档的轨迹的地方。它装甲保护的数据里存着每一次安静的卫星轻推、每一条被推离真实一丝的风暴带的模式；而过去关于洪水索赔与歉收的争执，在它的档案里留下淡淡的行政伤疤，那些伤疤像水流中的淤泥一样把这些文件引到了这里。回到边境星际站与那座废弃的听音哨，我们只看到损坏的脉冲与被拒绝的赔付；而在深空那场孤独的会合点，线索锐化成被改动的信标与盖尔银行代码——全都指向轨道上同一只看不见的手。

#en: PX-7708 hangs where the grav shear first bit through its hull, a dead weight on the edge of a corridor no sane pilot should have used once, let alone mapped. Whatever hand overrode Navy protocols and walked this ship into the teeth of the storm left its trail in the guidance banks and nav records no one has dared to sanitize. Out here, away from tribunals and insurance hearings, you can read those scars without filters, see whether a human navigator has been writing new rules for who lives and who vanishes. So far, the trail runs from a frozen lab full of twisted beacons to whispers about migrant convoys and quiet payments routed through Trade Authority shells, each step pointing to the same calm voice that treats storms like safe harbor.
zh: PX-7708悬在引力剪切最初咬穿它船壳的地方，是某条任何理智飞行员都不该用过一次、更别提测绘过的走廊边缘上的一坨死重。无论是什么手覆写了海军的协议、把这条船开进风暴的利齿，它都在制导库与导航记录里留下了痕迹——那些没人敢去清理的记录。在这里，远离法庭与保险听证会，你可以不加滤镜地读出那些伤疤，看是否有个人类领航员一直在为"谁活谁消失"写下新规则。目前为止，线索从一座塞满扭曲信标的冰封实验室，延伸到关于移民车队与经由贸易管理局空壳走账的安静付款的低语，每一步都指向同一个平静的声音——它把风暴当成避风港。

#en: Whatever was being tested here was never meant to see daylight, which is why it has to be erased in the same dead corridors where it was born. The outpost is long since emptied of researchers, but not of watchers; the Lima Devils haunt its halls now, treating the silent labs like inherited turf, guarding something they probably do not fully understand. Schedules here slipped years ago, one shortcut at a time, until dangerous work became just another box to tick and nobody noticed when the rules stopped matching the practice. So far I have followed a trail from a forgotten cache in the wilds to a derelict archive, then here, where the first proof that someone rewrote the frontier's soil was locked away and quietly folded into gang business.
zh: 在这里被测试的东西，从来就不该见到天日，所以它必须在它诞生的同一条死走廊里被抹掉。这座前哨的研究人员早已撤空，但监视者没有；利马恶魔如今出没于它的走廊，把那些沉默的实验室当成继承来的地盘，守着一些他们大概并不完全理解的东西。这里的日程多年前就一格一格地滑脱，一次抄近路接着一次，直到危险的工作变成又一个待勾选的方框，而没人注意到规则何时不再与实际相符。目前为止，我追着线索从荒野中一处被遗忘的储藏点，到一座废弃档案库，再到这里——"有人改写了边境的土壤"的最初证据，正是被锁在这里、并被悄悄折进帮派生意里的。

#en: Rumors at the edge of the system say the array has been watching longer than any survey charter, listening from just beyond where the charts grow thin. Some swear it caught a colony dying in real time, others whisper it tracks a single ship that never pings transponders the same way twice. What it actually recorded will show which empty lanes he trusts when he slips past LIST and Argos eyes, and where those lanes bend toward something no one wants to put in writing. So far, every fragment I have pulled points to poisoned settlements, scrubbed cargo approvals, and maintenance ghosts in Neon's underbelly, all circling one surveyor who understands that people will believe any story about the frontier except the one that blames their own hunger.
zh: 星系边缘的传闻说，那座阵列比任何勘探许可观测得都久，从星图开始变稀薄之处之外聆听。有人发誓它实时捕捉到一座殖民地死去，另一些则低语说它追踪着一艘从不以同样方式两次发出应答器讯号的船。它实际记录下的东西，会显示他在溜过独立盟与阿戈斯的眼皮时信任哪些空荡航道，以及那些航道在哪里弯向某个没人愿意写下来的东西。目前为止，我拉出的每一块碎片都指向被下毒的定居点、被擦净的货物审批，以及霓虹城下腹的维护幽灵，全都绕着一个勘探员打转——他明白，人们会相信任何关于边境的故事，除了那个把矛头指向他们自己饥饿的故事。

#en: OM-2098 rides dark in its patrol arc, a UC SysDef hulk still broadcasting clean credentials while whole decks hang half-powered and uninspected. If there was ever a place for something to pass quietly under the Navy's nose, it is here, buried in an overworked command net that trusts its own transponders more than its crew. The same culture that treated tug hands as expendable let this ship become a blind spot, and that blind spot is where the numbers on Rivet's trail finally align with official records and the people who doctored them. So far, the path runs from a forgotten rock and a discarded slate to scattered yard rumors, a grieving family's recording, and a Trade Authority broker who remembered the wrong pilot asking the right questions.
zh: OM-2098在其巡逻弧线上黑暗地巡航，一具联殖星防队的船壳，仍在广播着干净的身份凭证，而整层整层的甲板却半功率、未经检查地悬着。若说有什么地方能让某物悄悄从海军的鼻子底下通过，那就是这里——藏在张过度劳累、信任自家应答器甚于信任船员的指挥网里。正是那种把拖船工当成可消耗品的文化，让这艘船变成了盲点；而那个盲点，正是"铆钉"线索上的数字终于与官方记录、以及与那些涂改它们的人对齐的地方。目前为止，这条路从一块被遗忘的岩石与一块被丢弃的数据板，延伸到零散的船坞传闻、一段悲痛家属的录音，以及一名记得"错误"飞行员问过正确问题的贸易管理局掮客。

#en: The KN-4320 drifts under bruised starlight, its hull lights dead, its transponder still whispering UC SysDef credentials that no one has questioned in far too long. Out here, away from patrol lanes and busy grav wells, the silence around a sanctioned tactical ship is its own alarm. Whatever was pulled from investigation archives and routed through this frame was meant to stay buried in an empty sector, where Vector's experiments and the system's embarrassment could coexist unnoticed. A forgotten dataslate in the frontier, a nervous clerk's mismatched permits, and telemetry leaks from an old simulator all say the same thing: someone has been reshaping official routes with outlaw math, and command let the signs float out here, unseen, for years.
zh: KN-4320在淤青般的星光下漂着，船壳灯光熄灭，应答器仍在低声念叨着联殖星防队的身份凭证——太久没人质疑过它们了。在这里，远离巡逻航道与繁忙的引力井，一艘受认可战术舰周围的沉默本身就是警报。凡是从调查档案里抽出、经这具船体转运的东西，都被打算留在空旷星区里埋着——在那里，"向量"的实验与体制的难堪可以互不打扰地共存。边境一块被遗忘的数据板、一名紧张文书对不上的许可证，以及一台旧模拟器的遥测泄漏，都在说同一件事：有人一直在用法外之徒的数学重塑官方航线，而指挥部让这些迹象在此处无人看见地漂了许多年。

#en: Up here the city peels away, leaving only steel bones, humming relays, and the crackle of the Conduction Grid clawing at the sky. This is where she can stand above every antenna and uplink in Neon, splice her signal into Ryujin feeds and Trade Authority channels at once, and loose years of stolen memories before anyone can cut the power. Winds carry the ozone stink of overworked capacitors, and every flash of lightning across the span could be another packet of truth or another lie set in stone. You chased her trail from a buried dataslate in the dust, to quiet questions in Neon's heart, to a courier drifting cold in the dark; each step showed the same ghost signature, the same careful edits, and faces that remembered just enough to be afraid.
zh: 在这上面，城市层层剥落，只剩下钢铁骨架、嗡鸣的中继，以及抓挠天空的"输电网格"的噼啪声。正是在这里，她能站在霓虹城每一根天线与上行链路之上，把自己的信号同时接进龙神的传输流与贸易管理局的信道，在任何人切断电力之前放出多年偷来的记忆。风里带着过载电容器那股臭氧味，而横贯桥架的每一次闪电都可能又是一包真相、或又一个被钉死的谎言。你追着她的痕迹，从尘土里一块被埋的数据板，到霓虹城心脏地带安静的提问，再到一艘在黑暗中冷寂漂着的信使船；每一步都显示出同一个幽灵签名、同样谨慎的编辑，以及那些记得刚好够多、以至于害怕的脸。

#en: The farm sits where the frontier thins out, half-swallowed by dust and silence, a place supply routes once skirted and then simply forgot. That is why the trail converges here: nobody bothered to sanitize the records, scrub the consoles, or pull the last map off the wall when the crops turned bad and the locals walked. Directive Coldfront holds the ground now, too professional for raiders, too temporary for settlers, guarding something they likely do not fully understand, just following coordinates and pay slips. Earlier, a stray dataslate in a lonely shack led to whispered testimony about armed escorts at miracle fields, and both pointed toward a pattern of hidden corridors and rerouted shipments that all bear the same careful, Scottish hand.
zh: 这座农场坐落在边境变稀薄之处，被尘土与沉默半吞，一个补给航线曾经绕行、随后干脆忘掉的地方。正因如此，线索才汇聚于此：当作物变坏、当地人离开时，没人费心去清理记录、擦净控制台，或把最后一张地图从墙上撕下来。如今据守这片地面的是"冷锋"指令组——对掠夺者来说太专业，对定居者来说太临时，守着一件他们大概并不完全理解的东西，只是遵照坐标与薪水行事。早先，一座孤独棚屋里散落的数板牵出了关于"奇迹农田"处武装护航的低语证词，两者都指向一种由隐藏走廊与改道货运构成的模式——全都带着同一只谨慎的、苏格兰式的手笔。

#en: Whoever left these route traces out here did it in a hurry, then came back later and tried to scrub them clean; you can see it in the broken timestamps, the gaps where jump data should be, the way official patrol logs suddenly get very neat around the same days. This is not just navigation history, it is a record of who knew she was bending the lanes and how close they came to catching her before somebody higher up decided it was safer to pretend none of it ever happened. Trouble is, secrets like that leak; an Aegis agent with too many questions vanishes to the fringe, smugglers start talking about "haunted corridors," and a dead LIST slate on a forgotten rock lines up just a little too well with convoy "malfunctions" no one wants on the books.
zh: 在外面留下这些航线痕迹的人，做得匆忙，之后又回来试图把它们擦干净；你能从破碎的时戳、本该有跃迁数据的空缺，以及官方巡逻日志在同样那几天突然变得极其整洁中看出来。这不只是导航史，而是一份记录：谁早知道她在掰弯航道、他们离抓住她有多近，然后某个上级决定假装这一切从没发生过更安全。麻烦在于，这种秘密会泄漏：一名问题问得太多的宙斯盾特工消失到了边境，走私者开始谈论"闹鬼的走廊"，而被遗忘岩石上一块死掉的独立盟数据板，与那些没人愿意记入账册的车队"故障"对得实在太巧了些。

#en: The old drop shelter sits exactly where smugglers and raiders like to vanish between radar sweeps, its hull half-swallowed by dust and forgotten report files. Inside, the air tastes of stale propellant and burned circuitry, the kind of place a nervous liaison would hole up to sort contraband routes in peace, far from officers with questions and clients with guns. Whatever he kept here was meant to be revisited, adjusted, expanded, but the scattered bottles and half-packed crates say he left in a hurry and never circled back. All you have so far is a dead courier's fractured nav slate and whispers that the same pilot's name haunts both that trail and this bunker, hinting that these corridors were the first threads in a much longer invisible line.
zh: 那座旧投放掩体恰好坐落在走私者与掠夺者喜欢在两次雷达扫描之间消失的地方，它的外壳被尘土与废弃报告文件半吞。里面，空气尝起来像陈旧推进剂与烧毁电路的味道，是那种紧张的联络人会躲进来、安静整理违禁航线的场所，远离有问题的军官与带枪的客户。他留在这里的东西本打算再来复查、调整、扩充，可散落的瓶子和半打包的箱子说明他走得匆忙，再没绕回来。目前为止，你只有一名死掉信使破碎的导航数据板，以及"同一个飞行员的名字同时萦绕在那条线索与这座掩体上"的低语——暗示这些走廊是一条远更漫长的隐形线上最初几根线。

#en: The AR-6086 Gunspire hangs in the dark like a loaded die someone forgot to roll, squatting over a patch of empty orbit no trade lane ever bothers to cross. Whatever ledger of routes and stresses Torque has been feeding his patterns into would have to be kept somewhere no auditor or shipyard clerk could stumble across it by accident, and a gunship turned silent warden fits the superstition perfectly. Every spacer who mentioned this hull gave a different version of what it guards and who it answers to, but the details always circle the same path: a ghost outpost, an off-the-books cache, a SysDef derelict whose altered patrols and scrubbed logs keep pointing back to the same mechanic and the same quiet string of near-failures no one wants written down.
zh: AR-6086 枪塔悬在黑暗中，像一枚被人忘记掷出的灌铅骰子，蹲守在一片没有任何贸易航道愿意穿过的空荡轨道上。无论"扭矩"一直在把自己的模式喂进哪本航线与应力的账册，那本账都必须放在任何审计员或船坞文书都不会碰巧撞见的地方，而一艘变成沉默看守的炮舰完美契合这种迷信。每一个提起这具船壳的太空劫匪，都对它守着什么、听命于谁有不同版本，可细节总是绕着同一条路：一座幽灵前哨、一处账外储藏点、一具星防队弃船——它被改动的巡逻与擦净的日志不断指回同一名机修工，以及那一串没人愿意写下来的安静险情。

#en: Out here, skimming the dark limb of an unnamed world, the noise drops away until only grav tides and reactor hum remain, and that is exactly the kind of silence she needs to write her own corrections into everyone else's maps. The relay sitting in this orbital blind spot has been sampling every ship that dares a shortcut, folding their mistakes and near-misses into a pattern only she understands, while the hired guns circling it think they are guarding nothing more than another piece of junk. Back in the capital the archivist whispered about erased warnings, and the first corrupted logs on that forgotten rock showed identical hands on the course corrections; every story since then has repeated her name with a little more fear and a little less blame.
zh: 在这里，贴着某颗无名世界的幽暗边缘掠过，噪声褪去，只剩引力潮与反应堆的嗡鸣，而这正是她需要的那种寂静——好把她自己的修正写进别人的星图里。坐镇这个轨道盲点的那座中继，一直在对每一艘胆敢抄近路的船进行采样，把它们的错误与险情折成一个只有她懂的模式，而绕着它转的雇佣枪手以为自己在守的不过是又一件废铁。在首都，档案员低声说起被抹除的警告，而被遗忘岩石上最初那些损坏日志显示，航向修正出自同一双手；此后每一个故事重复她的名字时，恐惧都多一分，责怪都少一分。

#en: The dead Deimos yard hangs crooked over the moonlet like a rusting confession, every torn hull plate and silent crane a reminder of who taught this place how to come apart. Only here could she twist the machinery she once served into a shelter, a weapon, and a blind spot in UC surveillance, feeding stolen relay fragments into old shipbreaker systems while rival hunters close in. The pattern of her flight has always curved back to scrap and secrecy, and this is the last patch of metal she can still call her own. From the support ship we pulled a corrupted trail of seized hardware; in the mine, we found proof that someone paid well to bury her name. No one said what they were really afraid of, only that if we kept following the cuts, we would find her.
zh: 那座死掉的火卫二场区歪斜地悬在小卫星上方，像一份生锈的忏悔，每一块被撕裂的船壳板与每一台沉默的吊臂都在提醒：是谁教会了这地方如何解体。只有在这里，她才能把她曾效力的机械扭成庇护所、武器，以及联殖监视里的一个盲点，在对手猎人逼近时把偷来的中继碎片喂进旧拆船系统。她飞行的模式总是弯回废料与隐秘，而这是她仍能称作自己的最后一块金属。从支援船上，我们拉出了一条被损坏的截获硬件轨迹；在矿场里，我们找到了有人花大价钱掩埋她名字的证据。没人说他们真正怕的是什么，只说如果我们继续顺着那些切口追下去，就会找到她。

#en: The moonside cargo relay sits in the dark between worlds, a forgotten joint in the freight skeleton where manifests go missing and sealed tanks change ownership without ever touching a customs screen. This is where people like the broker make their real living, shaving truth off the numbers for whoever pays best, and where the pattern of diverted water and ghost shipments can finally be seen without the noise of a busy port. Crack the paper-thin lies here and the routes Catalyst favors stop being rumor and start becoming coordinates. So far the trail runs from a broken dataslate on a dead rock to nervous haulers in Neon's back alleys, all whispering about tankers off the books and a hydrologist who treats trade lanes like veins to be rerouted at will.
zh: 那座卫星侧货运中继坐在世界之间的黑暗中，是货运骨架上被遗忘的一个关节：舱单在此失踪，密封储罐在此易主，却从不经过海关屏幕。这里正是像那位掮客这样的人真正谋生的地方——为出价最高者从数字上削去真相；也正是"被改道的水"与幽灵货运的模式终于能在没有繁忙港市噪声干扰下被看清的地方。在这里敲开那些纸一样薄的谎言，"催化剂"偏爱的航线就不再是传闻，而开始变成坐标。目前为止，线索从死寂岩石上一块损坏的数据板，延伸到霓虹城后巷里紧张的货船船员，他们都在低声议论账外的罐车，以及一名把贸易航道当成可随意改道的血管的水文学家。

#en: Out in the thin glow above the planet, the deep space recon grid still listens, a rusted halo of sensors no one bothered to decommission because no one bothered to remember it existed. This is where raw grav noise becomes pattern, where tiny shifts in a ship's course are recorded long before flight control decides what the official story should be. If someone has been cutting their own lanes through restricted sky, the proof will be in these forgotten echoes, split time stamps and mismatched vectors quietly archived and never reviewed. You have already chased ghost readings from an abandoned station and unearthed buried scans in an old bunker, each hinting at a lone navigator slipping past patrol grids along paths the public charts never acknowledged.
zh: 在行星上方那片稀薄辉光里，深空侦察网仍在聆听——一圈锈蚀的传感器光环，没人费心退役它，因为没人费心记得它存在。这里正是原始引力噪声变成模式的地方，是船只航向里微小的偏移在飞行控制决定官方故事该是什么样之前很久就被记录下来的地方。若有人在受限天空中切出自己的航道，证据就会在这些被遗忘的回声里：被拆分的时戳与对不上的向量，被悄悄归档、从不复核。你已经追过一座废弃星际站的幽灵读数，也在一座旧掩体里挖出过被埋的扫描数据，每一处都暗示一名孤独的领航员沿着公开星图从不承认的路径溜过巡逻网格。

#en: Down in The Well, the air hums with recycled water and secondhand stories, the kind of place where routes are bought in whispers and no one ever claims to be the source. If MacLeod has been moving dangerous cargo and people through the cracks of the Settled Systems, the records of who paid, who looked away, and which ports opened at the wrong hour will be anchored here, buried under layers of favors and deniable transactions. Every dockhand, broker, and drifter swears they only heard his name from someone else. So far, the trail runs from that first stray dataslate to anxious settlers on the fringe and a glowing farm that should have failed, each step tightening the circle around one man who understands supply lines better than any government auditor.
zh: 在深井区，空气因循环水和二手故事而嗡鸣，是那种航线靠低语买下、且从没人承认自己是来源的地方。如果麦克劳德一直在把危险货物与人送过定居星系的裂缝，那么"谁付了钱、谁转开了视线、哪些港口在错误的时刻开放"的记录就会锚定在这里，埋在层层人情与可否认交易之下。每个码头工、掮客与流浪者都发誓自己只是从别人那里听到他的名字。目前为止，线索从最初那块散落数据板，延伸到边境上焦虑的定居者与一座本该失败的发光农场，每一步都收紧着围绕一个人的圆圈——他比任何政府审计员都更懂供应链。

#en: New Homestead matters because this is where the sky has been bent into his argument. The old colony relies on clean approaches to keep its lifeline intact, and Vector has rewired those beacons into the spine of his final chart, forcing every inbound ship to ride the edge of his math. If he finishes here, the corrected routes he broadcasts will ripple through the wider network, rewriting more than this one world's sky and locking his lattice in before anyone can refute it. The trail to this point started with a buried dataslate on a forgotten rock, then a survivor's haunted testimony in this same settlement, and finally a corrupted relay hanging in quiet orbit, each step tightening the pattern around one navigator who never stopped adjusting the lanes.
zh: 新家园之所以要紧，是因为天空正是在这里被他掰成了自己的论点。这座旧殖民地仰赖干净的进近来维持其生命线完整，而"向量"已把那些信标重新接线，成了他最终星图的脊柱，迫使每一艘入港船只都沿着他数学的边缘飞行。若他在这里完工，他所广播的修正航线就会在更大的网络中扩散，改写的将不止这一颗世界的天空，并在任何人能反驳之前把他的网格锁死。通往这一步的线索始于一穷乡星上被埋的数据板，然后是这座定居点里一名幸存者被纠缠的证词，最后是一颗悬在安静轨道上损坏的中继；每一步都收紧着围绕一名从未停止调整航道的领航员的模式。

#en: In the husk of the depot, amid half-drained power cells and cargo that never found a buyer, the old routing spine still hums, feeding quiet instructions into the beacon grid every time a freighter passes nearby. This is where Vector tested his math against real ships and real lives, burying his work in the same forgotten infrastructure the Spire Skulls now strip for scrap and blood money. Cut this node and the pattern of his hand in the lanes will stand out at last, however he has tried to diffuse it through abandoned hardware and missing manifests. So far the trail has been a string of dead haulers, encrypted logs under a decommissioned base, and freight records that all point back to one vanished consultant who keeps rewriting the same few corridors.
zh: 在那座货运站的空壳里，在半耗尽的电池与从未找到买家的货物之间，旧的航线脊柱仍在嗡鸣，每当有货船经过附近，它就把安静的指令喂进信标网。这里正是"向量"拿真实船只与真实人命检验他那套数学的地方，他把自己的作品埋进同样被遗忘的基础设施——如今尖塔骷髅正把它们拆成废料与血钱。切断这个节点，他在航道中的手笔模式终于会凸显出来，无论他曾如何试图用废弃硬件与失踪舱单把它摊薄。目前为止，这条线索是一串死掉的货船、一座退役基地下加密的日志，以及指向同一名消失顾问的货运记录——他不断改写着同样那几条走廊。

#en: Out here the stories say he talks to his clients through dead hardware, riding along on forgotten relays and survey beacons nobody bothered to decommission. This lonely rig in high orbit fits the pattern too well to ignore, and the crew of the Riftclaw is not babysitting it for charity. If there is a signal that links his math to a real departure point, it will be hidden in whatever this platform has been quietly forwarding. So far the trail is all secondhand talk and half-sanitized records a corrupted slate on a backwater rock, a doctored manifest in a wandering freighter's hold, a war-era sim that does not quite agree with itself each rumor pointing to the same soft-voiced navigator who keeps turning blind spots in the net into private thoroughfares.
zh: 在这里，故事说他通过死掉的硬件与客户交谈，附着在被遗忘的中继与没人费心退役的勘探信标上。高轨道上这座孤零零的设备太契合这个模式，无法忽视，而"裂隙爪"的船员可不是在做慈善看护它。若说有哪个信号把他的数学与一个真实的出发地系在一起，它就会藏在这座平台一直在悄悄转发的任何东西里。目前为止，这条线索全是二手说辞与半清理过的记录：穷乡岩石上一块损坏的数据板、一艘漂游货船货舱里被做手脚的舱单、一段与自己都不太对得上的战时模拟——每一则传闻都指向同一名嗓音柔和、不断把网中盲点变成私人通途的领航员。
