#en: Deimos has always been where things go to sit too long, from old hulls to unpaid invoices, and the scrapyard is where both finally start to blur together. Here, under frozen floodlights and half-stripped frames, manifests outlive the ships they belong to, and paper trails cling to rusted bulkheads long after GalBank pretends they were closed. If there is a record of who has been quietly redirecting assets and escorts, it will be buried under these retired keels, watched by contractors who know the value of a forgotten registry stamp. So far the trail is a mislaid slate in lonely orbit, freight that never matched its paperwork in crowded Gagarin bays, and a hand in Neon's shadows redrawing safe routes for those who paid in the right kind of desperation.
zh: 火卫二一直是东西放置太久的地方，从旧船壳到未付的账单，而废料场正是两者最终开始模糊在一起之处。在这里，在冻结的泛光灯与半剥光的框架下，舱单活得比它们所属的船只更久，纸面痕迹黏在锈蚀舱壁上，久久之后盖尔银行才假装它们已被结清。若说还有记录显示谁一直在悄悄改道资产与护航队，它就会埋在这些退役龙骨之下，由那些懂得一枚被遗忘登记章之价值的承包商看守。目前为止，线索是孤独轨道上一块放错位置的数据板、加加林星拥挤货舱里从未与文书对上的货物，以及霓虹城阴影中一只为那些付出"正确类型的绝望"的人重画安全航线的手。

#en: The abandoned relay bunker sits exactly where the patrol grid frays, a forgotten knot of concrete and antennae that once listened to every ship cutting through this slice of sky. Whatever those stolen scan logs recorded, they were taken here, under codes that still recognize UC clearance and still echo with the fugitive's passage through restricted airspace. If any record survived the purge orders, it will be buried in these darkened consoles, in the gaps between official routes and the paths a cautious engineer would carve for himself. The trail has been pulling you this way since that corrupted buoy in orbit, each rumor and registry error bending toward the same pattern of vanished hulls and one stubborn signature threaded through every quiet disaster.
zh: 那座废弃中继掩体恰好坐落在巡逻网格磨损之处，一团被遗忘的混凝土与天线结，曾经聆听每一艘切过这片天空的船。无论那些被盗的扫描日志记录了什么，它们都是在这里被取走的，所用的代码至今仍认得联殖权限，仍回响着那名逃犯穿越受限空域的经过。若说还有任何记录在清除令中存活，它就会埋在这些变暗的控制台里，埋在官方航线与一名谨慎工程师会为自己凿出的路径之间的空隙里。自从轨道上那枚损坏的浮标之后，这条线索就一直把你往这边拉，每一则传闻和每一处登记错误都弯向同一个模式：消失的船壳，以及一个穿在每一场安静灾难里的顽固签名。

#en: If his equations touched flesh and blood anywhere, it is here, in the star-station that quietly logs every grav-scarred pilot and every misjumped freighter under the language of medicine. The Clinic is where route experiments stop being theory and start leaving lesions on nervous systems, and its archives are thick with redacted scans and off-the-record consultations that someone like him would need to refine a corridor no one else can see. What began as a half-heard spacer tale in a remote rock, then a doctored cargo log on a wandering hauler, then an old war sim from a forgotten bunker has become a story retold in waiting rooms and freight bars a rumor of a soft-voiced navigator whose math keeps showing up wherever ships vanish without leaving wreckage.
zh: 如果说他的方程曾在任何地方触碰血肉，那就是这里——这座星际装置用医学的语言悄悄记录着每一名带着引力伤疤的飞行员和每一艘错跳的货船。星际诊所号正是航线实验不再是理论、而开始在神经系统上留下病灶的地方；它的档案里塞满了涂黑的扫描与不留记录的问诊——像他那样的人需要这些来打磨一条别人看不见的走廊。起初只是偏远岩石上半听来的太空劫匪故事，然后在某艘漂游货船上成了被做手脚的货运日志，再从一座被遗忘掩体里成了旧战时模拟——如今它已变成在候诊室与货运酒吧里被反复讲述的故事：一个嗓音柔和的领航员，只要船只消失而不留残骸，他的数学就会冒出来。

#en: The busted hulls and stripped frames in this yard are just the bones; the real story is in whatever data the scavvers were too scared or too stupid to wipe. If someone has been bending safe lanes around an unseen point, the first honest record of that curve will be in the navigation guts of ships that never made it back to port, and this is where their remains ended up. The Dust Backlot Boys are squatting here for a reason, clinging to a pile of rust and half-dead cores like it is a throne, arguing over scrap while something cleaner and quieter hums in the background. So far the trail holds a stray dataslate on a forgotten rock, gossip about vanished convoys, and a pattern of "malfunctioning" traffic that all seems to slip past Deimos before it disappears.
zh: 这座场区里破损的船壳与被剥光的框架只是骨头；真正的故事在那些拾荒者因为太害怕或太愚蠢而没抹掉的数据里。若有人一直在绕着一个看不见的点掰弯安全航道，那条曲线的第一份诚实记录就会存在于从未回港的船只的导航内脏里，而这里正是它们残骸最终落脚之处。尘埃后院帮蹲在这里是有原因的，抓着一堆锈铁与半死的核心像抓着王座，一边为废料争吵，一边有某个更干净、更安静的东西在背景里嗡鸣。目前为止，这条线索里有被遗忘岩石上一块散落数据板、关于失踪车队的闲话，以及一种"故障"交通模式——它们似乎都在消失之前先溜过火卫二。

#en: The moonside relay sits in permanent twilight, a forgotten cargo node clinging to rock and thin atmosphere, built for routine manifests and quiet bribes, not questions. Here is where routes are nudged a little wider, escorts trimmed a ship or two, risk buried under cheap drinks and exhausted clerks who sign off whatever their console prints, then rotate out before the pattern ever sinks in. The broker who worked this desk has already moved on, pockets heavier, conscience light, leaving only one record of the tiny course changes they were paid to process. So far the trail is a dead dataslate in a remote dust patch and whispered talk of altered shipping lanes; this relay's logs are the first proof that those "minor variances" are deliberate, not coincidence.
zh: 那座卫星侧中继处于永久的暮光之中，一个攀附在岩石与稀薄大气上的被遗忘货运节点，为例行舱单与安静的贿赂而建，而不是为了问题。这里正是航线被推宽一点、护航被裁掉一两艘船的地方，风险被埋在廉价酒水与精疲力竭的文书之下——他们照签控制台打印出来的一切，然后在模式沉淀下来之前轮岗离开。在这张桌子前干过的掮客早已转场，口袋更沉、良心更轻，只留下一份记录，记着那些有人付钱让他处理的微小航向改动。目前为止，线索是偏远尘土中一块死掉的数据板与关于被改动航道的低语；这座中继的日志是第一份证据，证明那些"微小差异"是刻意的，而非巧合。

#en: The depot squats at the edge of nowhere, tanks half-drained, consoles running on flicker and habit. It is the kind of place routes pass through, not linger in, which makes the abandoned ledgers and unsent status reports feel louder than the wind howling across the pads. Someone meant to clean this data, balance the tallies, erase the discrepancies, then never came back to finish the job. Buried in those numbers is the pattern of ships steered off their declared paths, the hidden corridors that all point toward the same unseen hand. So far, the trail runs from a nameless dead drop to this forgotten fuel stop, with only a scavenged dataslate and a handful of altered refueling records to prove that something, or someone, has been quietly re-drawing the lanes.
zh: 那座货运站蹲在天涯之外，储罐半空，控制台靠闪烁与惯性运转。这是那种航线只穿过、不停留的地方，正因如此，那些被弃置的账册与未发出的状态报告，听起来比呼啸过停机坪的风还响。有人本打算清理这些数据、平掉账目、抹掉那些差异，然后再没回来完工。埋在这些数字里的，是船只被推离申报路径的模式，是那些全都指向同一只看不见之手的隐藏走廊。目前为止，线索从一处无名死信点，延伸到这座被遗忘的加油站，只有一块捡来的数据板与几份被改动的加油记录，能证明有什么东西、或某个人，一直在悄悄重画航道。

#en: From this hut, the land opens in two directions, each scarred in ways no natural weather should repeat so precisely. The scout's instruments caught twin bands of heated air and scoured rock that mirror each other across the valley, as if someone has been testing parallel approach lanes over the same frontier settlements. Standing among faded Freestar flags and worn sensor rigs, you can read the sky the way a navigator would, see how passing ships would be nudged into one corridor or the other without ever noticing. What started as a single twisted beacon in a frozen lab has become a chain of anomalies, a derelict Navy run cut too close to shear, and now matching wounds in the terrain, all lining up until coincidence is the least convincing explanation left.
zh: 从这座小屋望去，大地朝两个方向铺开，每一侧都以任何自然天气都不该如此精确重复的方式留下伤疤。侦察兵的仪器捕捉到两条被加热的空气带与被刮蚀的岩石，它们在谷地两侧彼此镜像，仿佛有人一直在同一批边境定居点上方测试平行的进近航道。站在褪色的自由星系联盟旗帜与磨损的传感器设备之间，你能像领航员那样解读天空，看出过往船只会如何被推入这一条或那一条走廊、却浑然不觉。起初只是某座冰封实验室里一座扭曲的信标，如今已成一串异常、一次贴近剪切面过近的废弃海军航行，以及现在地形上相互对应的伤口——它们全都排成一线，直到"巧合"成为最没有说服力的解释。

#en: The little scout drifts at the edge of the lane like a smudge someone meant to erase and forgot, its UC markings half-scorched, its transponder still whispering into dead space. If there is anywhere his private geometry would be preserved intact, it is in a Navy hull he once trusted to test new paths, a place no civilian audit would dare pry into. Inside, you can feel the pause in the story, as if some clerk or SysDef handler planned to sweep the logs, file the incident, close the book, and simply never showed up. The trail to this point has been all loose ends and absences: a discarded slate on a backwater rock, a shuttered relay strangled with bad data, and now a military scout where the jump curves finally start to repeat the same quiet, calculated hand.
zh: 那艘小侦察船漂在航道边缘，像一道有人打算抹掉却忘了的污痕，它身上的联殖标识半焦，应答器仍朝死寂太空低语。若说他的私人几何有哪里会被原封不动地保存，那就是一艘他曾信任、用来测试新路径的海军船壳——一个任何民用审计都不敢撬开的地方。里面，你能感觉到故事里的一处停顿，仿佛某个文书或星防队经手人本打算清扫日志、归档事件、合上卷宗，然后就干脆没露面。通往这一步的线索全是松开的线头与缺席：穷乡岩石上一块被丢弃的数据板、一座被坏数据勒住喉咙的关闭中继，以及如今一艘军用侦察船——在这里，跃迁曲线终于开始重复同样那只安静、算计的手。

#en: Out here on the moonside relay, traffic is supposed to be simple: fuel, food, ore, all logged and cleared through a single crooked broker who knows which crates to ignore. That makes this the one place where her trail would condense into numbers and routes, where someone has quietly reconciled stolen medical shipments, missing couriers, and ships that never filed returns. The walls hum with old transmissions, and the dust on half these consoles says nobody asked the right questions for a very long time. So far the line runs from a dead slate on an empty rock, through doctored logs at Gagarin and whispered panic in Neon's back alleys, to this relay where the manifests finally admit how often the same soft-spoken courier passed through without anyone noticing.
zh: 在这座卫星侧中继上，交通本该很简单：燃料、食物、矿石，全部登记、全部经由一名知道该无视哪些货箱的歪斜掮客放行。这让它成了她那条线索唯一会凝聚成数字与航线的地方——在这里，有人悄悄对上了被盗的医疗货运、失踪的信使，以及从未提交报告回执的船只。墙壁因旧传输而嗡鸣，而这一半控制台上的尘土说明，很久没人问过正确的问题了。目前为止，这条线从空岩石上一块死掉的数据板，穿过加加林星被做手脚的日志与霓虹城后巷里压低声音的恐慌，延伸到这座中继——在这里，舱单终于承认：同一名嗓音柔和的信使，多么频繁地在无人注意下经过。

#en: The farm is the last vessel in her chain, the place where all those quiet adjustments to air and instinct finally resolve into something irreversible. Out here, far from New Atlantis tribunals and Neon rumor, she can test a full ecosystem in silence, scrub it clean, and vanish before the results reach any clinic chart. The stillness over the dead fields is no accident; every intake vent and rusted sprayer hums with intention, tuned to erase witnesses, evidence, even mood. Leaving her here would mean letting the pattern repeat somewhere larger. From the relay logs to the doctored autopsies and that broken smuggler schedule in orbit, every small crossed wire and delayed message pointed to one truth: wherever the air went wrong, she had already been there first.
zh: 这座农场是她链条上的最后一环，是所有那些对空气与本能做出的安静调整最终凝结成不可逆之物的地方。在这里，远离新亚特兰蒂斯城的法庭与霓虹城的传闻，她能在寂静中测试一整套生态系统、把它擦干净，并在结果登上任何诊所图表之前消失。死寂田地上空的那种静止绝非偶然；每一个进气口与锈蚀的喷淋器都在带着意图嗡鸣，被调校来抹掉证人、证据，乃至情绪。把她留在这里，就等于让这个模式在更大的地方重演。从中继日志到被做手脚的尸检，再到轨道上那份损坏的走私者日程，每一处小小的错接与延迟的消息都指向同一个真相：凡是空气出错的地方，她都已经先到过了。

#en: Cydonia's central corridors hum with recycled air and distant mining rigs, a place where flow rates and freight lists matter more than names or faces. In all this ordered movement, the pattern of one hidden pipeline can decide which settlements drink and which slowly choke. That is why the trail bends here, into the crowded arteries of shipping clerks and transit monitors, where a single misfiled route can mask an illegal cistern shifting quietly between worlds. Records have been patched, overwritten, and half-erased, but the seams show if you look close enough. Out on a dead rock, a damaged slate whispered of altered timetables; in Neon's alleys, haulers spoke of ghost tankers; every fragment points to someone steering water where no charter says it should go.
zh: 赛多尼亚的中央走廊因循环空气与远处的采矿设备而嗡鸣，这地方流量与货运清单比名字和面孔更重要。在这套有秩序的运动中，一条隐藏管道的模式就能决定哪些定居点有水喝、哪些慢慢窒息。正因如此，线索才在这里拐弯，钻进由航运文书与运输监控构成的拥挤动脉——在这里，一条归档错误的航线就能掩住一座在星系之间悄悄转移的非法蓄水池。记录被打过补丁、被覆写、被半擦除，可只要你凑得够近，接缝就露出来了。在死寂岩石上，一块损坏的数据板低语着被改动的时间表；在霓虹城的小巷里，货船船员谈论着幽灵罐车；每一块碎片都指向有人在把水引向任何特许状都不该允许它去的地方。

#en: This is the only place his numbers can become irreversible action. The occupied base hums on off-the-books power, its corridors patrolled by mercenaries who are paid from accounts no one admits exist. Here, behind improvised blast doors and jammed comm relays, Deadlock is no longer a rumor in a ledger but the hand that signs the last transfers, settles old scores, and prepares to erase anyone who can still prove what he has done. The way the hirelings talk, low and careful, says they know one loose word can cost more than their contract. So far the trail has run from a stray dataslate in the dark to hushed dealings at a busy port and a nervous patrol crew sitting on falsified manifests, each step tightening the pattern around one man who turns debts into weapons.
zh: 这是唯一能让他那些数字变成不可逆行动的地方。那座被占据的基地靠账外电力嗡鸣，它的走廊由雇佣兵巡逻——他们的薪水来自没人承认存在的账户。在这里，在临时拼凑的防爆门与堵塞的通讯中继之后，"死锁"不再是账册里的传闻，而是签署最后几笔转账、清结算旧账、并准备抹掉任何还能证明他所做之事的人的那只手。那些雇工说话的方式——压低、谨慎——说明他们知道一句失言可能比他们的合同更贵。目前为止，线索从黑暗里一块散落数据板，延伸到某座繁忙港市的低声交易与一支坐在伪造舱单上的紧张巡逻队，每一步都收紧着围绕一个人的模式——他把债务变成武器。

#en: Down here, beneath the polished surface of New Atlantis, the noise of pumps and crowded corridors covers the kind of quiet work Deadbolt always favored. The old hydro systems and jury-rigged power taps give him places to hide the patterns that never belonged on any official console, buried in the numbers of water flow and shift rosters. This is where he learned to read human lives as timing problems, where a few nudged schedules or delayed messages could steer whole crews without them ever knowing. So far the trail shows the same hand behind a forgotten dataslate in the black, altered orders on a courier, and a scrubbed Navy log; every step poisoned by small miscommunications, each one nudged just enough to shape the collision course you are now trying to unwind.
zh: 在这下面、在新亚特兰蒂斯城光洁表面的底下，水泵的噪声与拥挤的走廊掩盖着"死栓"一向偏爱的那种安静工作。旧水力系统与临时拼凑的取电口，给了他藏匿那些从不属于任何官方控制台之模式的地方——埋在水量与轮班名册的数字里。正是在这里，他学会把人命当作时间问题来读，在这里，几处被轻推的日程或延迟的消息就能操纵整队船员，而他们浑然不觉。目前为止，这条线索显示，黑暗中一块被遗忘的数据板、一艘信使船上被改动的命令，以及一份被擦净的海军日志背后是同一只手；每一步都被细小的沟通失误所毒害，每一处都恰好被推得刚好足以塑成你此刻正试图解开的那条相撞航向。

#en: Gagarin Landing is where the stories keep changing, and that alone makes it the right place to start cutting through them. Dockside clerks swear the same convoys left on safe, straight corridors, while haulers hunched over cheap drinks insist the routes bent at the last minute, always into the same patch of bad sky. Manifests and traffic records here are the first hard ground under all that shifting talk, the only way to see whether the lanes were rewritten in transit or in some back office with a quiet payoff. So far all I have are murmurs from captains about familiar paths that should not match, a few redacted insurance notes that spike around the same dates, and a name spoken with that wary mix of respect and dread people reserve for ghosts and debt collectors.
zh: 加加林着陆点，就是那些说法不断变化的地方，仅此一点就让它成为切开它们的正确起点。码头边的文书发誓同样的车队是从安全笔直的走廊离开的，而弓身伏在廉价酒水上的货船船员则坚称航线在最后一刻拐了弯，而且总是拐进同一片糟糕的天空。这里的舱单与交通记录是那片变动说辞之下第一块硬地，是看清航道究竟是在运输途中、还是在某间后室靠一笔安静的酬金被改写的唯一办法。目前为止，我只有船长们关于"不该对上的熟悉路径"的低语、几份在同样日期集中出现的涂黑保险备注，以及一个被念出时带着那种人们专留给幽灵与讨债人的、戒备的敬意与恐惧的名字。

#en: Neon Starport is the one place he cannot fully script the outcome: too many ships cycling grav drives, too many maintenance crews chasing quotas, too many innocent bystanders who will take the brunt of any failure he chooses to prove a point with. Here he can vanish into the noise of refit schedules and falsified inspections, finish seeding his backdoors into outbound traffic, and walk away while the Settled Systems slowly tear themselves apart. The pattern that began in a quiet frontier facility, wound through a cold orbital clue, and surfaced in a drifting SysDef hull now narrows to this single, crowded dock; every record points to the same mechanic, the same signature stress patterns, and a message that stays maddeningly clear yet hard to pin to anyone but him.
zh: 霓虹城太空港是他唯一无法完全编排结果的地方：太多船只在循环引力引擎，太多维修组在追配额，太多无辜的旁观者会替他选择用来证明自己的任何一次失败承受冲击。在这里，他能消失进修配日程与伪造检查的噪声里，完成把后门播进出港交通的最后一步，然后在定居星系慢慢自我撕裂时走开。那个始于某座安静边境设施、穿过一条冰冷的轨道线索、并在一具漂着的星防队船壳上浮现的模式，如今收窄到这一个拥挤的船坞；每一份记录都指向同一名机修工、同样标志性的应力模式，以及一条清晰得令人抓狂、却除了他之外难以安到任何人头上的消息。

#en: The trail bends through this forgotten research module because this is where someone got careless first. A half-sanitized console, a misfiled routing key, one experiment left running on background cycles long after its sponsor pulled funding; small oversights that let a quiet data-thief splice new geometry into corporate networks. What was once a routine telemetry node became a hidden hinge, quietly relaying altered jump corridors and storm maps toward a place he considers safe to test his theories. Out on that backwater homestead, the weather went wrong by degrees; in the abandoned listening post, warnings cut out mid-stream; now the disrupted theft chain, half-scrubbed logs, and converging contract codes all trace back to the same unseen hand re-drawing the sky.
zh: 线索拐过这座被遗忘的研究舱，因为这里正是有人最先疏忽的地方：一台只清理了一半的控制台、一把归档错误的航线钥匙、一个在赞助方撤资很久之后仍在后台循环运行的实验；这些小小的疏忽，让一名安静的数据窃贼得以把新几何接进公司的网络。一个曾经例行的遥测节点变成了隐藏的铰链，悄悄把被改动的跃迁走廊与风暴图转发向一个他认为可以安全检验自己理论的地方。在那座穷乡农庄，天气一点点变坏；在废弃的听音哨里，警告在传输中途中断；如今，被打断的盗窃链条、半擦除的日志与汇聚的合同代码，全都追溯回同一只重画天空的无形之手。

#en: Out here the old relay hangs against the dark, a dead node on every official chart, yet its arrays still whisper on hidden bands no one bothered to decommission. Vector chose this place because forgotten procedures never stopped listening, never stopped folding stray grav noise into the silent patterns she worships. Every jump echo, every misaligned lane she has engineered funnels back through these antique circuits, feeding the proof she needs to vindicate herself and condemn the rest. If she completes her work here, those echoes harden into routes others will blindly follow. So far the trail has run through stolen UC sensor logs, Slayton debrief fragments, and relay data that all showed the same impossible reflections, each pointing back to her hand on the lanes.
zh: 在这里，那座旧中继悬于黑暗之中，是所有官方星图上的一个死节点，可它的阵列仍在没人费心退役的隐藏频段上低语。"向量"选中这里，是因为被遗忘的程序从未停止聆听，从未停止把零散的引力噪声折进她所膜拜的那些安静模式里。每一次跃迁回声、每一条她设计出的错位航道，都回流穿过这些古旧电路，喂养她为自己翻案、并谴责其余人的证据。若她在这里完工，那些回声就会硬化成别人会盲从的航线。目前为止，这条线索穿过被盗的联殖传感器日志、斯莱顿述职残片，以及全都显示出同一种不可能映像的中继数据，每一处都指回她搭在航道上的那只手。

#en: The GC-5222 Stockwind hangs dead in the dark, yet its holds hum with the kind of silence only a bank-funded courier can afford. This is where GalBank buried the numbers behind the stories, where route audits and risk models were meant to keep corridor manipulation theoretical, not lethal. If Zuri ever tested a prototype outside Trident, the echoes of that first deviation would be archived here, wrapped in encryption and insurance jargon, half-forgotten by the clerks who filed it. Whatever version of the tale started all this has already been sanded down by rumor. So far, the trail runs through a lonely cache on some backwater rock, a corrupted beacon in orbit, and scattered traffic reports, all pointing to someone quietly rewriting how ships move between the stars.
zh: GC-5222 存风死寂地悬在黑暗中，可它的货舱嗡鸣着一种只有银行资助的信使船才养得起的沉默。这里正是盖尔银行把故事背后的数字埋起来的地方，是航线审计与风险模型本应用来让"走廊操弄"停留在理论层面、而非致命的地方。如果祖里曾在海神叉之外测试过原型，那次最初偏差的回声就会被归档在这里，裹在加密与保险术语里，被归档它的文书半遗忘。无论引发这一切的是哪个版本的故事，它都早已被传闻打磨钝了。目前为止，这条线索穿过某块穷乡岩石上一处孤独的储藏点、轨道上一座损坏的信标，以及零散的交通报告，全都指向有人在悄悄改写船只如何在群星之间穿行。

#en: High above Neon's glow, where maintenance rails meet the crackle of the Conduction Grid, the air is full of forgotten routines: old alignment pings, defunct landing protocols, guidance sweeps no one bothered to shut down. Up here, those abandoned systems still tug at shipboard software, gently bending approach vectors into the same narrow band of sky. That quiet, mechanical habit is what the cartographer has been riding, hiding his edits inside the pulse of a city that never sleeps.  \n\nSo far the trail runs from a stray dataslate in backcountry rock to a buried monitoring pod full of censored telemetry, each pointing to the same conclusion: someone has been folding new routes into old habits, letting obsolete systems whisper his patterns into every passing drive.
zh: 在霓虹城辉光的高处，维修轨道与"输电网格"的噼啪声相接，空气里满是被人遗忘的程序：旧的对齐脉冲、作废的降落协议、没人费心关掉的制导扫描。在这上面，那些被弃置的系统仍在拉扯船载软件，把进近向量轻轻掰进同一条狭窄的天空带。那位制图师一直在利用的，就是这种安静而机械的习性——把自己动手脚藏进一座从不入睡的城市的脉搏里。  \n\n目前为止，线索从乡间岩石上一块散落数据板，延伸到一座塞满被审查遥测的被埋监控舱，每一处都指向同一个结论：有人一直在把新航线折进旧习惯，让作废的系统把他的模式低语进每一块经过的硬盘。

#en: The Freestar Security hulk hangs in its decaying orbit like a bad decision that never quite finished falling, her hull scarred by an overstrained drive and the kind of precision failure that does not happen by chance. This is where the paper trail of burned-out coils and missing ships becomes more than rumor; freighters do not die this cleanly unless someone has been testing the same pattern over and over. Inside her frozen corridors, system logs and routing records will show which lanes were altered, who signed off, and how far his work has already spread. So far the trail runs from a forgotten beacon buried in rock to whispers in freight yards and redacted reports in UC files, every scrap pointing to one navigator quietly rewriting how ships move through the dark.
zh: 那具星联警卫残骸悬在它正在衰减的轨道上，像一个从未真正落到底的糟糕决定；它的船壳被超负荷的引擎与那种绝非偶然的精密失效留下一道道伤疤。这里正是"烧毁线圈与失踪船只"的纸面线索不再只是传闻的地方；货船不会死得这么干净，除非有人一遍又一遍地测试同一个模式。在它冻结的走廊里，系统日志与航线记录会显示哪些航道被改动、是谁签的字，以及他的工作已经扩散到多远。目前为止，线索从岩石里一座被埋的遗忘信标，延伸到货运场里的低语与联殖档案中被涂黑的报告，每一点碎片都指向一名领航员——他在悄悄改写船只如何在黑暗中穿行。

#en: Out here, the abandoned shipping depot is more than rusted loaders and forgotten crates; it is where the paperwork died and the cargo kept moving. Every misrouted pallet, every container quietly written off, passed through places like this until Amal learned to bend those blind corners into escape routes. The depot's dormant scanners, dead records, and empty loading bays give her exactly what she needs to vanish one last time, folding new thefts into old losses until no auditor can untangle the trail. The scattered consoles and sealed manifests still carry the fingerprints of your route in: a stray dataslate on a lonely rock, nervous corporate whispers in a lab, a dead relay humming with false vectors, each step carving faint grooves that finally all converged here.
zh: 在这里，那座废弃航运站不只是锈蚀的装载机与被遗忘的箱子；它是文书死掉、而货物继续流动的地方。每一托盘被引错路的货、每一个被悄悄注销的货柜，都经过这样的地方，直到阿迈勒学会把那些盲角掰成逃生路线。货运站里休眠的扫描仪、死掉的记录与空荡的装货湾，恰好给了她最后一次消失所需的东西——把新的盗窃折进旧的损失，直到任何审计员都解不开这条线索。散落的控制台与密封的舱单仍带着你入场路线的指纹：孤独岩石上一块散落数据板、某间实验室里紧张的公司低语、一座嗡鸣着虚假向量的死中继，每一步都刻下浅浅的沟槽，最终全都汇聚到这里。

#en: If any trace of his work exists outside hidden relays and dead freighters, it will be here, buried in the quiet corners of a station that has seen too many wars and rewritten too many charts in the name of mercy. The Clinic sifts every anomaly and medical oddity in the Settled Systems, its archives thick with grav-drive case files, misjump trauma reports, and sensor logs no one else bothered to read. Somewhere in that tangle, his patterns will surface, if they were ever recorded at all. So far the trail is a chain of almost-coincidences a corrupted dataslate in the back of nowhere, falsified manifests on a wandering freighter, a military log that does not agree with itself every step pointing to a vanished navigator whose routes keep intersecting with missing ships.
zh: 如果说他的工作还有任何痕迹存在于隐藏中继与死掉货船之外，那它就在这里，埋在某个见证过太多战争、并以慈悲之名改写太多星图的星际站安静的角落里。星际诊所号会筛检定居星系里的每一处异常与医学怪象，它的档案里塞满了引力引擎病例、错跳创伤报告，以及没别人费心去读的传感器日志。在那团乱麻里的某处，他的模式会浮现出来——如果它们曾被记录过的话。目前为止，这条线索是一连串"几乎巧合"：天涯之外一块损坏的数据板、一艘漂游货船上被伪造的舱单、一份与自己都不一致军事日志，每一步都指向一名消失的领航员——他的航线不断与失踪的船只相交。

#en: Ebbside is where Neon breathes out its lies, and the air down here tastes like rust, Aurora, and recycled sweat. Every back wall has a pipe humming behind it, and the people who live under those pipes swear someone has been whispering new rules into the flow: sudden pressure drops, cloudy taps, tankers loading at hours no schedule admits. If there is a pattern, it will surface first in the mouths of the desperate, drunks and dockhands arguing over whether they saw a Dryline crew tapping a line or just imagined it through the haze. So far, all I have are a corrupted slate from some nowhere rock and scattered complaints that the water tastes wrong wherever her name is spoken, but the shape of the story keeps circling Neon and the kind of work no one files paperwork for.
zh: 埃布赛德是霓虹城呼出谎言的地方，这里的空气尝起来像铁锈、极光与回收的汗味。每一面背墙后面都有一根管道在嗡鸣，而住在那些管道下的人发誓，有人一直在往水流里低语新的规则：突然的压降、浑浊的水龙头、在没有日程承认的时段装水的罐车。若说有什么模式，它会最先从绝望者口中浮出——酒鬼与码头工争论他们究竟看见过一支干线城市群的小队私接管道，还是只是透过雾气想象出来的。目前为止，我只有某块鸟不拉屎岩石上一块损坏的数据板，以及零散的抱怨说只要提到她的名字水就变味；可这个故事的形状，不断绕着霓虹城与那种没人会为它填表的工作打转。

#en: Out on this forgotten rock, the cargo ledgers are still written in grease and guesswork, not encrypted cores. This is where a tug with the wrong hull ID could vanish into a "clerical error," where one harried dockhand and a misheard decommission code might quietly reroute an entire ship's fate. The records here are crooked but honest about it; buried in their crossed-out entries and duplicated manifests is the first clean bend in Rivet's trail, the moment his courier slipped from official hands into the graveyard circuit. So far the path runs from a stray slate and half-remembered yard gossip to a grieving relative's recording and a hint of altered traffic logs, all pointing toward one burned cutter and the way someone used paperwork and neglect to make him disappear.
zh: 在这块被遗忘的岩石上，货运账册仍是用油污和猜测写成的，而不是加密核心。这里正是船体 ID 对不上的拖船能消失在"文书记录错误"里的地方，也是某个焦头烂额的码头工加一个听错的退役代码，就能悄悄改变整艘船命运的地方。这里的记录歪歪斜斜，却对自己诚实；在那些被划掉的条目与重复的舱单里，埋着"铆钉"线索上第一个干净的弯——他的信使船从官方手中溜进墓地回路的那一刻。目前为止，这条路从一块散落数据板与半模糊的船坞闲话，延伸到一名悲痛亲属的录音，以及被改动交通日志的蛛丝马迹，全都指向一艘被烧毁的切割船，以及有人如何利用文书与疏忽让他消失。

#en: It had to end down here, where his life with LIST began, among the recycled air and humming conduits that fed the surface its comforts while the people below drowned in backlog. The Well is his last instrument, a place wired deep into the colony grids and routing archives he once tended, perfect for purging records, rewriting risk models, and priming the next wave of "acceptable losses" before anyone notices the pattern. By the time you arrive, those slow changes he set in motion have nearly hardened into policy. Out there, a stray dataslate in the wilderness led to an orbital beacon, then to buried files on a dead ice colony and corporate whispers in Neon. Each clue tightened the arc around a LIST coordinator who never stopped editing the fate of other people's homes.
zh: 它必须在这下面终结——在他在独立盟的人生开始的地方，在那些为地表输送舒适、却让下面的人淹死在积压里的循环空气与嗡鸣导管之间。深井区是他最后的工具，一个深深接进他曾照料的殖民地网格与航线档案的地方，最适合清除记录、改写风险模型，并在任何人注意到模式之前预备下一波"可接受的损失"。等你抵达时，他启动的那些缓慢变化已几乎硬化成政策。在外面，荒野中一块散落数据板引出了一座轨道信标，然后是一座死寂冰封殖民地里的被埋文件与霓虹城的公司低语。每一条线索都收紧着那道弧线，围绕一名从未停止编辑别人家园命运的独立盟协调员。

#en: The old barracks sit half-buried in dust and bad memories, the kind of place paperwork said was cleared years ago, which is exactly why a scavenger crew can work here without anyone asking questions. Salvage Crown Union have stripped wiring from the walls and pried plates from the floor, but they have not touched the heart of the records room, too busy chasing quick metal to notice what the consoles still remember. One missed shutdown order, one archive never properly wiped, and the past has been looping quietly ever since, listing bodies that never made it home. All you have, so far, is a blood-stained tent outside Akila, a clerk in Gagarin whispering about impossible death payouts, and a rumor from New Atlantis that a spacer walked away from their own recorded demise.
zh: 那座旧营房半埋在尘土与糟糕记忆里，是那种文书声称多年前就已清空的地方——这正是拾荒者小队能在此作业而没人发问的原因。打捞王冠工会已把墙里的线缆抽走、把地板上的板子撬开，但他们没碰记录室的核心，忙着追抢快钱，没注意到那些控制台还记得什么。一条被漏掉的关停命令、一座从未被妥善擦除的档案库，从那以后过去就一直在悄悄循环，列着那些从未能回家的躯体。目前为止，你只有阿基拉城外一顶血迹斑斑的帐篷、加加林星上低声说起"不可能的身故赔付"的文书，以及来自新亚特兰蒂斯城的一则传闻：一名太空劫匪从自己被记录在案的死亡里走了出去。

#en: Neon's underside is where the city forgets to pretend it cares, and that neglect is exactly why he chose it. Under the Conduction Grid's crackle, between leaking conduits and back-alley data stalls, hazard warnings blur into background noise and nobody looks twice at another survey tech obsessively checking air quality. Here, his patterns of "calibration anomalies" can hide inside a hundred other scams, and the same familiarity that keeps Underbelly regulars alive has dulled them to any new danger he brings. The trail to this place began with a stray dataslate on a dead rock, led through orbital debris and a quiet Trade Authority hulk, each clue pointing to doctored worlds, desperate settlers, and one surveyor determined to prove that no one really reads the fine print.
zh: 霓虹城的底面，是这座城市忘记假装在意的地方，而这种忽视正是他选中它的原因。在"输电网格"的噼啪声下，在渗漏的导管与后巷数据摊之间，危险警告模糊成背景噪声，没人会对又一名执拗地检查空气质量的勘探技师多看一眼。在这里，他那些"校准异常"的模式能藏进上百种别的骗局里，而那种让下城常客活下来的熟悉感，已让他们对他带来的任何新危险都麻木了。通往这里的线索始于一死寂岩石上一块散落数据板，穿过轨道碎片与一具沉默的贸易管理局船壳，每一处线索都指向被做手脚的世界、走投无路的定居者，以及一名决心证明"没人真的会看细则"的勘探员。

#en: This dead relay station sits exactly where the altered corridors start to drift, a quiet kink in the map no one admits to owning. Its dishes still listen, just enough power bleeding through the bones for buried code to ride the static. That is why it matters; every recalculation, every quiet course correction that nudged ships off the main lanes passed through here first, scrubbed and forwarded by hands who knew better than to ask why. Cipher Blackfire holds it now, hired to guard a story whose first telling is already smothered under revisions. So far the trail runs from a forgotten outpost, to a glitched beacon in orbit, to a derelict courier full of mismatched traffic logs, all pointing toward someone rewriting the sky and paying killers to keep the edits unchallenged.
zh: 这座死掉的中继站恰好坐落在被改动的走廊开始漂移之处，星图上一个没人承认自己拥有的安静扭结。它的天线盘仍在聆听，骨骼里渗出的电力刚好够埋藏的代码乘着静电运行。这就是它要紧的原因：每一次重算、每一次把船只推离主航道的安静航向修正，都先经过这里，被那些懂得不该问为什么的手擦净并转发。"暗码黑火"现在占着它，受雇看守一则连初次讲述都已被修订稿闷死的故事。目前为止，线索从一座被遗忘的前哨，到轨道上一座故障信标，再到一艘塞满对不上交通日志的弃置信使船，全都指向有人在重写天空，并付钱给杀手让那些改写无人质疑。

#en: Trade Authority does not lose ships like this, not without twenty layers of paperwork and a salvage crew already inbound, which makes the Starborne tumbling dark and alone feel wrong from the first scan. Its cargo holds are empty of goods but thick with movement in the manifests, the same names and routes echoing across different runs like someone rehearsing the same trick over and over. Whatever this freighter was forwarding for him, it passed through legitimate ledgers often enough to look like chance until the patterns started to stack. So far I have a corrupted slate from a forgotten rock, a string of altered entries tied to this derelict's haul history, and a growing list of "coincidental" crossings where ships on those paths either arrived early, late, or not at all.
zh: 贸易管理局不会这样丢船——不丢个二十层文书、并且打捞队已经在路上的话；这让黑暗而孤独地翻滚着的"星裔"从第一眼扫描起就显得不对劲。它的货舱里没有货物，可舱单上的动向却很密集，同样的名字与航线在不同航次之间回响，像有人一遍又一遍排练同一个把戏。无论这艘货船在替他转运什么，它都频繁经过合法账册，直到那些模式开始叠加之前，看起来都像巧合。目前为止，我有一块来自被遗忘岩石的损坏数据板、一串与本弃船运输史相关的改动条目，以及一份越来越长的"巧合"交叉清单——走在那些路径上的船只，要么早到、要么晚到、要么根本没到。

#en: A place that measures burn rates and timing windows is the only groundside spot where his math ever touches dirt, so the trail runs through these tanks and ledger screens whether anyone meant it to or not. The crew squatting here now were hired to watch fuel, not secrets, but shifts in contracts, cut corners, and old favors turned a simple depot into a choke point for quiet diversions. Schedules bent a little, then a little more, and nobody reset them when the original planners moved on, leaving the proof half-buried in routine refills. So far the pattern shows a dead relay on the edge of nowhere, a missing stretch of corridor carved out of official charts, and a string of migrant launches from HopeTown whose fuel draws all lean toward the same off-angle shadow in the sky.
zh: 一个测量燃烧率与时间窗口的地方，是他的数学唯一会接触泥土的地面场所，所以这条线索无论如何都要穿过这些储罐与账册屏幕。如今蹲守在这里的船员是被雇来看燃料的，不是看秘密的，可合同变动、偷工减料与旧人情把一座简单的中转站变成了安静改道的咽喉。日程弯了一点，又弯了一点，而当最初的规划者调走后没人把它们复位，证据就半埋在例行的补给记录里。目前为止，这个模式显示的是一座天涯之外的死中继、一段从官方星图上被挖掉的缺失走廊，以及一串从霍普镇出发的移民发射——它们的燃料消耗全都倒向天空中同一道偏角的阴影。

#en: Wind-scoured fields and broken irrigation lines make this place the perfect blind spot; no patrols, no curious neighbors, just ruined rows where a man like Dustback can finish what others only started. The abandoned farm still carries the memory of tainted trials and quiet cover-ups, the kind of ground he trusts more than any safehouse, because everyone who mattered here already walked away without ever understanding what they set in motion. Now he uses that neglect as shelter, tying off the last threads of his work where no one thinks to look. So far we have followed scattered data from a forgotten cache, half-scrubbed logs in a dead research site, and corporate whispers in a remote module, all pointing to the same freight hand who never really stopped working these fields.
zh: 被风刮蚀的田地与破损的灌溉线让这地方成为完美的盲点；没有巡逻队、没有好奇的邻居，只有一排排毁坏的垄沟——像"尘背"这样的人可以在那里完成别人只开了个头的事。那座废弃农场仍带着被污染试验与安静掩盖的记忆，那是他信任甚于任何安全屋的土地，因为这里每一个曾经要紧的人都已经离开，却从没弄明白自己启动了什么。如今他把这份荒废当作庇护，在没人想着去看的地方系紧自己工作的最后几根线。目前为止，我们追着零散数据从一处被遗忘的储藏点，到一座死掉研究站里半擦除的日志，再到某个偏远舱室里的公司低语，全都指向同一名从未真正停止在这些田里干活的货运工。

#en: Ryujin Tower is where stories go to be rewritten in contract language, and somewhere deep in its labs is the first trace of how this one started to bend. The samples locked behind those glass doors are more than just experimental biomatter; they are patterned in the same strange way her jump trails are, quiet fingerprints of a pilot who keeps slipping between official narratives. Whatever she traded them for, it happened here, under security cams and non-disclosure clauses, long after the first rumor of a lost squadron began mutating in spacer bars. So far, all you really have are scattered bar talk about a Vanguard wing that never came home, a LIST convoy that got improbably lucky in bad space, and a name that keeps showing up on altered routes and corrupted insurance logs.
zh: 龙神大楼，是故事被用合同语言改写的地方，而在这栋楼实验室深处的某处，藏着这个故事最初如何开始弯折的第一道痕迹。锁在那些玻璃门后的样本不只是实验用生物质；它们的图案与她跃迁轨迹的奇怪方式如出一辙，是一名不断在官方叙述之间溜过的飞行员的安静指纹。无论她拿它们换了什么，交易都发生在这里，在安保摄像头与保密条款之下，远在"失踪中队"的第一则传闻开始在太空劫匪酒吧里变异之后。目前为止，你真正拥有的只有零散的酒吧闲谈——关于一支从未回家的先锋队飞行队、一支在糟糕空域里运气好得不像话的独立盟车队，以及一个不断出现在被改动航线与损坏保险日志上的名字。

#en:
Out here the relay clings to a dust-scoured moon, half-forgotten by the traffic it once watched, which is exactly why the broker chose it.  
Its isolation lets manifests drift off the official grid and into quieter ledgers, the kind smugglers and route-cutters trust more than any central archive.  
Anything tracing back to manipulated jumps and profitable wrecks would pass through a place like this, tucked into back rooms where conversations die to murmurs the moment a stranger steps in.  
The same hushed voices pointed you here: a found dataslate in the backcountry, a spooked crew on a small freighter who had seen the same accident pattern twice, then a relay-side fence who flinched at the name of a navigation analyst and hinted that some routes only exist in the margins.
zh:
在这里，那座中继紧紧贴着一颗被尘土刮蚀的卫星，被它曾注视过的交通半遗忘——这正是那位掮客选中它的原因。  
它的与世隔绝让舱单能漂离官方网格、进入更安静的账册，那种走私者与航线切割者信任甚于任何中央档案库的账册。  
凡是能追溯出"被操弄的跃迁与有利可图的残骸"的东西，都会经过这样的地方，藏在陌生人一进门谈话就降成呢喃的后室里。  
同样那些压低的声音把你指向这里：乡间一块捡到的数据板、一艘小货船上被吓坏的船员（他们两次见过同样的意外模式），然后是一名中继旁的销赃商——听到某位导航分析员的名字就一缩，并暗示某些航线只存在于页边。

#en: The research module is the kind of place procedures go to sleep: half-lit corridors, unattended consoles, maintenance drones still cycling through routines no one has monitored in years. Somewhere in the stacks, a misconfigured process has been quietly following off-pattern traffic, filing away jump data and cargo tags long after the project that created it was shut down and forgotten. If anything still remembers where her diversions really went, it is buried in those obsolete schedulers and half-archived logs. So far the trail is a string of neglected habits and lingering code: an outpost that kept logging the same ship twice, lab records that aligned with no official corridor, and a remote relay that continued recording phantom transits long after its operators walked away.
zh: 这座研究舱是那种程序会打瞌睡的地方：半亮的走廊、无人看管的控制台、仍在循环多年来无人监控例程的维护无人机。在某个资料堆里，一个配置错误的进程一直在悄悄跟踪非模式的交通，在一个创造它的项目早已被关停遗忘之后仍不断归档跃迁数据与货物标签。若说还有什么仍记得她的改道真正去了哪里，它就埋在这些过时的调度器与半归档日志里。目前为止，这条线索是一串被忽视的习惯与残留代码：一座把同一艘船记录两次的前哨、与任何官方走廊都对不上的实验室记录，以及一座在操作员离开很久后仍继续记录幽灵通行的远程中继。

#en: It has to be here, hung in the thin hush above an unremarkable world, where traffic is sparse and sensor noise is low enough that a single altered route can stand out like a scar across the sky. The ship holding position ahead, the VR-3488 Crossline, sits just off standardized lanes, anchored in a pocket of empty space no autopilot would choose. Whoever seeded this orbit knew how to hide in plain geometry, trusting that most captains would dismiss the stories as spacer gossip, misread beacons, or exaggerations from nervous haulers. You have already chased a discarded lead from a lonely rock and sifted the gutted logs of a silent courier; each fragment pointed to the same handwriting in the vectors, the same careful hand turning storms and empty space into shelter for one man.
zh: 必须在这里——悬在一颗平平无奇世界上方那片稀薄的静默中，那里交通稀疏、传感器噪声低到一条被改动的航线能像天空上一道伤疤那样显眼。前方保持位置的那艘船，"VR-3488 横线"，就停在标准航道外侧，锚定在一片任何自动驾驶都不会选择的空荡太空中。把这条轨道播下种子的人懂得如何在赤裸的几何里藏身，笃信多数船长会把那些故事当作太空劫匪的闲话、被误读的信标，或紧张货船船员的夸大。你已经追过一块来自孤独岩石的被丢弃线索，也筛过一艘沉默信使船被掏空的日志；每一块碎片都指向向量上同样的笔迹，同一只谨慎的手把风暴与空荡太空变成一个人的庇护所。

#en: The old relay bunker still hums under the dust, a leftover nerve ending from when the patrol grid actually mattered out here. Someone cut the staffing, locked the doors, walked away but never quite killed the systems; the scanners kept sweeping the sky on autopilot, quietly catching what no one was supposed to see. Buried in those half archived sweeps are the tracks of a ship that slipped through restricted airspace again and again, always on the same heading, moving like a man who knows where the blind spots are because he helped design them. So far the chase has turned up a forgotten dataslate on a nowhere rock and carved patterns in a gutted yard, both pointing to a salvage hand with old ties to UC lanes and a habit of treating every battlefield like it still belongs to him.
zh: 那座旧中继掩体仍在尘土下嗡鸣，是巡逻网格在这片区域还真正有意义时留下的一截神经末梢。有人裁掉了人员、锁上门走人，却从未真正关掉系统；扫描仪在自动驾驶下继续扫过天空，悄悄捕捉着没人该看到的东西。埋在那半归档的扫描记录里的，是一艘一次又一次溜过受限空域的船的轨迹，它总是同一航向，移动得像一个知道盲点在哪的人——因为他参与设计了那些盲点。目前为止，这场追查挖出了一穷乡岩石上被遗忘的数据板与被掏空场区里刻下的图案，两者都指向一名与联殖航道有旧交情、并且习惯把每一片战场都当成仍属于自己的打捞工。

#en: Neon's underbelly is where paper trails come to hide behind neon runoff and steam, where manifests are just as likely to be sold, forged, or buried as filed. If anyone is quietly routing ships through gaps in patrol coverage, their fingerprints will be down here in the rusted lockers and off-the-books ledgers the dock crews pretend not to see. The people who work these corridors live on looking away at the right time; whatever points to her paths will be tucked into that blind spot where fear of asking questions meets the need to get paid. So far the trail runs from that lonely frontier homestead to a broken beacon in high orbit, then to a derelict courier with its routes twisted just off standard lanes, each step tightening around the same pilot's invisible hand on the charts.
zh: 霓虹城的下腹，是纸面痕迹躲进霓虹污水与蒸汽后面的地方，舱单在那里被卖掉、伪造或埋葬的概率和归档一样大。若有人在悄悄把船只引过巡逻覆盖的空隙，他的指纹就会在下面这些锈蚀储物柜与码头工假装看不见的账外账册里。在这些走廊里讨生活的人，靠的就是在正确的时刻移开视线；任何指向她路径的东西，都会被塞进那个"怕问问题"与"需要拿到钱"相遇的盲点里。目前为止，线索从那座孤独的边境农庄，延伸到高轨道上一座损坏的信标，再到一艘航线被拧出标准航道外侧的弃置信使船，每一步都收紧着围绕同一名飞行员无形之手在星图上的位置。

#en: The Deserted Colony War Barracks is where the lie began to feel normal, a place built to process bodies until no one bothered to count them closely anymore. Walls that once echoed with triage calls now swallow the sound of bootsteps, and in that silence a medic who knew every corner could turn complacent record-keeping into a perfect blind spot. Here, among rusting bunks and faded casualty charts, she has been reworking histories for years, shuffling names between the living and the dead while Freestar and UC both looked away. The trail to this moment started with a forgotten dataslate in the dust, then a blood-stained tent outside Akila and a nervous clerk on Gagarin, finally circling through a buried UC relay where altered orders proved the pattern of carefully managed losses.
zh: 被遗弃的殖民地大战军营是谎言开始变得正常的地方，一座为处理躯体而建、直到再没人费心仔细清点的设施。曾经回响着分诊呼叫的墙壁，如今吞掉脚步声，而在那片寂静中，一名熟识每一个角落的医疗兵能把自满的记录习惯变成完美的盲点。在这里，在锈蚀的床铺与褪色的伤亡图表之间，她多年来一直在重编历史，把名字在生者与死者之间来回调换，而自由星系联盟与联殖都转开了视线。通往此刻的线索始于尘土中一块被遗忘的数据板，接着是阿基拉城外一顶血迹斑斑的帐篷与加加林星上一名紧张的文书，最后绕经一座被埋的联殖中继——在那里，被改动的命令证明了"精心管理的损失"这一模式。

#en: This backwater patch of ground is where the trail stops being theory and turns into stain. Whatever she tested here bled into the soil and air, a chemical fingerprint for the way she has been bending routes, contracts, and people without leaving neat records behind. Sampling it in place, surrounded by the same wind-scoured rock and forgotten equipment she used, is the only way to separate her work from all the other quiet poisons drifting through the Settled Systems. So far the picture is stitched from a half-corrupted log on a lonely outpost, a misaligned ping in high orbit, and a vault ship's inconsistent manifests, each fragment pointing in roughly the same direction while insisting on different details, as if everyone who touched this story remembered it just a little wrong.
zh: 这片穷乡之地，就是线索不再是理论、而变成污渍的地方。她在此测试的东西渗进了土壤与空气，成为一种化学指纹，标记着她一直在不留下整齐记录的情况下掰弯航线、合同与人。在实地取样，被同一片风蚀岩石与同一批她用过、被遗忘的设备环绕，是把她所做的一切与定居星系里其他所有安静毒物分开的唯一办法。目前为止，这幅图景是由一座孤独前哨上半损坏的日志、高轨道上一次错位的脉冲，以及一艘金库船前后不一致的舱单拼成的，每一块碎片都大致指向同一方向，却坚持不同的细节，仿佛每一个碰过这故事的人都记得它稍有偏差。

#en: HopeTown is where departures stop being stories on a LIST brochure and turn into stamped cargo, hull numbers, and fuel tallies, which means this is the only place the math of his vanishings might still be written down. Dock rats swear they remember a quiet pilot who always left on half-full tanks yet logged the same routes as everyone else, and old maintenance slates carry ghost entries that do not line up with the ships that actually left. Piecing it together from frayed manifests, half-wiped terminals, and a tired clerk's memory, the trail so far looks like this: an anonymous cache of nav data on a nowhere rock, a gutted relay whose logs were sliced into nonsense, and the same clean, uncanny jump profile repeating at every point where a colony's future simply fell off the map.
zh: 霍普镇，是离港不再只是独立盟宣传册上的故事、而变成盖了章的货物、船体编号与燃料统计的地方；这意味着，他那些人间蒸发背后的数学，也许还只在这里被写下来过。码头老鼠们发誓记得一名安静的飞行员，他总是带着半满的燃料箱离开，却登记着和所有人一样的航线；而旧的维护数据板带着与实际离港船只对不上的幽灵条目。用磨损的舱单、被擦掉一半的终端与一名疲惫文书的记忆拼凑，目前为止这条线索是这样的：某块鸟不拉屎岩石上一处匿名的导航数据储藏点、一座日志被切成胡言乱语的被掏空中继，以及同一个干净而诡异的跃迁剖面——它在一座殖民地未来从星图上掉落下去的每一个点上反复出现。

#en: This place is the only ground that makes sense for her to stand on. The Abandoned Deimos Scrapyard is everything she ever believed in and everything she was thrown away with, stacked into canyons of dead steel and half-born hulls. Here she can erase evidence with a torch stroke, cut loose any ship that might betray her, and vanish her ghost fleet back into the bones of the system if given a few more hours. The truth behind all of it feels simple enough to touch and yet slippery in the details: a wreckwright proving how fragile the lanes are. We traced the pattern from a forgotten dataslate in a backwater shed, to a silenced listening post where her maintenance tags were scrubbed, to a drifting Trade Authority support hulk wired with her weld signatures and falsified cargo trails.
zh: 这地方是她唯一站得住脚的地面。"废弃火卫二废料场"就是她曾信仰的一切，也是她曾与之一同被丢弃的一切，堆成一座座死钢与半成形船壳的峡谷。在这里，她能以一记喷枪抹掉证据，割断任何可能背叛她的船，若再多给她几个小时，还能把她的幽灵舰队化回这套系统的骨骼里。这一切背后的真相简单得仿佛触手可及，细节上却又滑不留手：一名残骸工匠在证明这些航道有多脆弱。我们追着这个模式，从穷乡棚屋里一块被遗忘的数据板，到一座她维护标签被擦净的被噤声听音哨，再到一具漂着的贸易管理局支援船壳——上面接满了她的焊接签名与伪造的货运轨迹。

#en: Out here, the relay husk still hums with ghost signals, its dishes frozen mid-swing toward a sky Vector has been quietly reshaping for years. This is one of his blind corners, a shell on the ground that anchors the misaligned constellations overhead, where he can rewrite flight paths, mute storm warnings, and route whatever the Master Archive is about to broadcast. If he finishes severing or retuning these channels, every settlement that ever trusted the sky will be flying on lies for good. Back on the fringe station, at that forgotten listening post, even the techs who showed me corrupted insurance logs and odd storm telemetry looked away when his callsign appeared. On the vault ship, GalBank records, LIST pings, and sensor contracts all bent toward the same quiet hand in orbit.
zh: 在这里，那座中继残壳仍因幽灵信号而嗡鸣，它的天线盘冻结在摆向中途，朝向一片"向量"多年来一直在悄悄重塑的天空。这是他的一处盲角，一个地面上的壳，锚定着头顶那些错位的星群；在这里，他能改写飞行路径、让风暴警告静音，并安排"主档案库"即将广播的任何内容。若他完成对这些信道的切断或重调，每一个曾信任天空的定居点都将永远飞在谎言之上。回到边境星际站、在那座被遗忘的听音哨里，连那些给我看损坏保险日志与古怪风暴遥测的技师，在他的呼号出现时都移开了目光。在那艘金库船上，盖尔银行记录、独立盟脉冲与传感器合同，全都弯向轨道上同一只安静的手。

#en: It had to end here, under the dripping conduits and humming grav trains, because this is where it started to go wrong for her. The queues outside the LIST office, the families sleeping on metal benches, the quiet bribes and desperate eyes all pressed Grid into the shape she finally chose; this warren of stairwells and service tunnels is the cradle of her anger and the market for her lies. From here she can disappear into crowds, erase herself in a dozen overlapping data trails, or slip one final batch of doctored approvals into the system before some new frontier dies for it. The pattern of dead applications, the poisoned farmstead, the broker in Neon, and the derelict cutter in deep orbit all point the same way now, back to the depths where she first learned how to bend the grid.
zh: 它必须在这里终结——在滴水的导管与嗡鸣的引力列车之下，因为这里正是她开始走错的地方。独立盟办公室外的长队、睡在金属长椅上的家庭、安静的贿赂与绝望的眼神，把"网格"压成了她最终选择的形状；这片楼梯井与维修隧道构成的迷宫，是她愤怒的摇篮，也是她谎言的市场。从这里，她能消失进人群，在十几条重叠的数据痕迹里抹掉自己，或在某片新边境因此死掉之前，把最后一批做过手脚的批准溜进系统。死掉的申请、被下毒的农庄、霓虹城的掮客，以及深空轨道上那艘弃置切割船的模式，如今都指向同一个方向——回到她最初学会如何掰弯这张网格的深处。

#en: Out here with the GB-3498 Stockwind tumbling in silent orbit, there is no PR officer, no broker, no claims adjuster to polish the numbers; only frozen corridors and abandoned cargo holds where the real balances were kept. GalBank will swear this loss was random misfortune on a certified corridor, but the way the hull is holed, the way emergency beacons were never armed, says somebody modeled the odds and stacked them. Somewhere in this dead ship are the ledgers and route amendments that tie a quiet navigator to calculated disasters and carefully timed payouts. Back in Gagarin I heard captains whisper about unlicensed lanes that all bent the same way, and every story about Vector since has circled the same pattern of low-risk routes that somehow only ever fail for the right clients.
zh: 在这里，"GB-3498 存风"在寂静轨道上翻滚，没有公关专员、没有掮客、没有理赔员去粉饰那些数字；只有冻结的走廊与被弃的货舱——真正的账目就存在那里。盖尔银行会发誓说这次损失是认证航道上的随机不幸，可船壳被破开的方式、应急信标从未被激活的方式，都说明有人计算过概率并做了局。在这艘死船里的某处，藏着那些把一名安静的领航员与精心算计的灾难、时机精准的赔付系在一起的账册与航线修订。回到加加林星，我听到船长们低声议论那些全都朝同一方向弯折的无证航道，而此后每一个关于"向量"的故事，都绕着同一种低风险航线模式——它们不知怎地只会"恰好"坑害正确的客户。

#en: The remote research module clings to the dark like it wants to be forgotten, yet its racks still hum with archived traffic the corporations swore they never kept. This is where side channels bled into black budgets, where quiet analysts fed routing experiments to clients who did not want their fingerprints on the math. Whatever was pulled from the chain here bent an entire relay network off true, and buried inside those records is the inflection point that turns rumor into a heading. Every tech, clerk, and broker who whispered about the ghost in the charts swears they heard it from someone else: a scorched dataslate on a derelict outpost, a scrubbed relay spewing ghost vectors, a nervous contact hinting that UC claims and Ecliptic payouts kept crossing the same name in the margins.
zh: 那座偏远研究舱紧贴着黑暗，像希望被人遗忘，可它的机架仍在嗡鸣着公司发誓从未保存过的归档交通。这里正是侧信道渗进黑预算的地方，是安静的分析员把航线实验喂给不愿在数学上留指纹的客户的地方。凡是从这里的链上被拉走的东西，都把整张中继网掰离了真实；而在那些记录里埋着的，是那个把传闻变成航向的拐点。每一个低声议论"星图中的幽灵"的技师、文书与掮客，都发誓自己是从别人那里听来的：一座弃置前哨上烧焦的数据板、一座喷吐幽灵向量的被擦净中继、一名紧张的线人暗示联殖索赔与黄道佣兵团的赔付不断在页边撞上同一个名字。

#en: Out on the plant perimeter, the air hums with stripped conduits and aging compressors, every pipe and silo still tuned to the same Helium-3 flows that once made entire colonies rise or fall on a spreadsheet. If anyone wanted to rewrite those numbers at the source, to bend extraction yields and shipping manifests beyond audit, it would have to be here, in the blind spot where ore becomes collateral and no one checks twice. Whatever Luc Schmit is about to do, this place lets it echo through ledgers from Narion to Cheyenne before anyone can agree what really happened. All we know for certain is a forgotten data-slate in the dust, odd discrepancies buried in Gagarin contracts, and a silent vault ship that should have been empty but carried echoes of the Credit Ghost instead of closure.
zh: 在工厂外围，空气因被剥光的导管与老化的压缩机而嗡鸣，每一根管道与料仓仍调校到同样的氦-3 流量——它们曾让整片殖民地在电子表格上崛起或崩塌。若有人想从源头改写那些数字，把开采产量与航运舱单掰到审计之外，那就必须在这里，在这个"矿石变成抵押品、没人会复核两遍"的盲点。无论吕克·施密特打算做什么，这地方能让它从纳里昂星到夏延星的账册里一路回响，赶在任何人就"究竟发生了什么"达成一致之前。我们能确定的只有：尘土里一块被遗忘的数据板、加加林星合同里埋着的古怪不符，以及一艘本该空无一物、却载着"信贷幽灵"回声而非了结的沉默金库船。

#en: Whichever way you tilt the sensors, this patch of orbit keeps sliding between stable solutions, a mathematical crossroads where two grav routes brush against each other without ever quite touching; it is exactly the kind of place a former stress analyst would use to hide a decision point in his models. The data out here was never meant for traffic control or survey charts, only for someone who knows how to read the split between safe lane and soft spot, and every hushed story you have heard in bars and backrooms treats this region like a name best not spoken too loudly. Up to now the trail has been a doctored accident report in a quiet lab, a cast-off slate of frantic equations, and a New Atlantis paper trail that suggests his work was quietly pushed off-world rather than corrected.
zh: 无论你把传感器朝哪边倾斜，这片轨道都在几个稳定解之间滑动，一处数学上的十字路口，两条引力路线在此相擦却从不真正接触；这正是前应力分析员会用来在模型里藏一个决策点的地方。这里的资料从来不是为交通管制或勘探星图准备的，只属于某个懂得如何解读"安全航道与软点之间那条缝"的人；而你在酒吧与密室里听过的每一个低声故事，都把这片区域当成一个最好别太大声说出的名字。到目前为止，这条线索是某间安静实验室里一份被做手脚的事故报告、一块写满狂乱方程的废弃数据板，以及一条新亚特兰蒂斯城的纸面痕迹——它暗示他的工作是被悄悄推出了行星之外，而不是被纠正。

#en: Out here on an unremarkable rock, the wind does most of the erasing. Sensor masts lean, soil scarred where someone set up more than a simple survey, then broke it down in a hurry. Whatever they were feeding into the local biosphere started in makeshift labs like this, far from auditors and after-action reports, where samples could be tested on quiet ground and any mistakes buried under dust and time. No one logged what was really mixed or released; all that remains is residue in the dirt and a few mismatched inventory tags. So far the trail has jumped from that abandoned frontier homestead with its unnatural calm, to the drifting beacon in orbit, to a courier whose routes were bent off the books, every step hinting at experiments tested in the dark and then scrubbed from the record.
zh: 在这块平平无奇的岩石上，风做了大部分的擦除工作。传感器桅杆歪斜，土壤上留着伤痕——有人在此架设的不只是简单的勘探，然后匆忙拆除。他们喂给本地生物圈的东西始于这样的临时实验室，远离审计员与行动后报告；在这里，样本能在安静的地面上被测试，任何错误都能被尘土与时间埋掉。没人记录究竟混合或释放了什么；留下的只有泥土里的残留物与几枚对不上的库存标签。目前为止，这条线索从那座"平静得不自然"的废弃边境农庄，跳到轨道上漂着的信标，再到一艘航线被拧出账册的信使船，每一步都暗示着在黑暗中被测试、随后从记录里被抹掉的实验。

#en: Nobody trusts what comes through this relay anymore, which is exactly why it matters. The place is dead on paper, yet its dishes still track passing hulls a little too closely, and rumor says someone rewired its heart to listen for cargo that is supposed to be gone. Lost Legion took it over quietly, like they were babysitting a story they do not want spreading: ex-soldiers watching an abandoned node no one officially maintains, waiting for patterns only they recognize. So far the trail is all whispers and half-logs: a misfiled ping on a lonely rock, corrupted records from a research station that never logged a distress call, and dockhands back in civilized space swearing they heard a tug's signature twice on the same approach while their supervisors insisted they were imagining things.
zh: 已经没人相信经过这座中继的东西了，而这正是它要紧的原因。这地方在纸面上是死的，可它的天线盘仍在把过往船体贴得稍微太近地追踪；传闻说，有人重接了它的心脏，专门监听那些"本该已经消失"的货物。失落军团悄悄接管了它，像在照看一则他们不愿扩散的故事：一群老兵看守着一个无人正式维护的废弃节点，等待只有他们认得的模式。目前为止，这条线索全是低语与半截日志：孤独岩石上一次归档错误的脉冲、一座从未记录过遇险呼叫的研究站里损坏的记录，以及文明星域里码头工发誓他们同一次进近听到了同一艘拖船的签名两次——而他们的主管坚称他们在胡思乱想。

#en: Out here, the planet is just a cold disc below and the real traffic runs along invisible lines, where one altered signal can nudge thousands of lives a fraction off course. This orbiting node matters because it sits dead center in that tangle, a quiet splice where sanctioned routes and someone else's corrections overlap. The freighter standing guard is no accident either; years of captains taking slightly faster paths, brokers shaving risk margins, and one navigator rewriting tolerances have all converged on this anonymous hull and the data it shields. So far, the trail has led from a buried cache of corrupted nav work on a forgotten world to a shaken colonist's testimony about a torn-apart convoy near an old homestead, each fragment pointing to the same hand quietly bending the lanes.
zh: 在这里，行星只是下方一枚冰冷的圆盘，真正的交通沿看不见的线运行——在那里，一个被改动的信号就能把成千上万条命推偏一点点。这座轨道节点之所以要紧，是因为它坐落在那团乱麻的正中央，一处"获批航线"与"别人的修正"重叠的安静接点。那艘负责警戒的货船也绝非偶然；多年船长抄稍快的路径、掮客削风险边际，以及一名领航员改写容差，全都汇聚到这具无名的船壳与它所保护的数据上。目前为止，这条线索从一颗被遗忘世界上被埋的损坏导航数据储藏点，延伸到一名受惊定居者关于某座老农场附近一支被撕碎车队的证词，每一块碎片都指向同一只悄悄掰弯航道的手。

#en: Gagarin's rusted gantries and humming server stacks are exactly where someone would hide the paperwork for stolen weather, buried among freight schedules and corporate maintenance chatter no one ever audits. The same off-world firms that gutted this place now rent floor after floor of storage and processing, a perfect blind for quietly shunting atmospheric data and shipment records through machines nobody claims to own. Whatever passes through here changes hands without leaving fingerprints, and the locals have learned which questions not to ask, which file names not to say aloud. So far the trail runs from a forgotten prefab, to a dead hunter's fractured report, to crop yields that defy their own forecasts; each stop adds another layer to the pattern she has been drawing across the sky.
zh: 加加林星锈蚀的龙门架与嗡鸣的服务器机柜，正是有人会藏"被盗天气"文书的地方——埋在从未被审计的货运日程与公司维护闲聊里。那些曾把这地方掏空的太空公司，如今一层接一层地租下存储与处理空间，一个完美的掩护，可以悄悄把大气数据与货运记录转经没人承认自己拥有的机器。凡是经过这里的东西都易手而不留指纹，当地人也学会了哪些问题不该问、哪些文件名不该念出声。目前为止，线索从一座被遗忘的预制房，到一名死掉猎人的零碎报告，再到违背自身预报的作物产量；每一站都为她在天空上画出的那个模式又添了一层。

#en: The junked drilling platform drifts just off the main lane, a forgotten node still whispering into the patrol grid with data nobody officially logged and nobody wants to talk about. Whatever has been guiding condemned hulls off their manifests is riding that signal, hiding behind obsolete tags and routine course corrections, and every day it stays live the pattern can shift again, burying the trail under a new layer of lies. Dockside gossips swear they know which routes to avoid, then fall quiet when you ask for specifics, suddenly unsure which stories they are allowed to repeat. So far all I have is a dead spacer's slate full of angry notes and a corrupted buoy that should never have carried retired UC codes, both pointing at a careful hand rewriting where broken ships are meant to die.
zh: 那座报废的钻井平台就漂在主航道外，一个被遗忘的节点，仍在朝巡逻网格低语着没人正式记录、也没人愿意谈论的数据。一直在引导报废船壳脱离舱单的东西，正骑着那道信号，藏在过时的标签与例行的航向修正之后；而它每多存活一天，模式就能再次漂移，把线索埋进新一层谎言里。码头边的爱嚼舌者发誓他们知道该避开哪些航道，可当你追问细节时就沉默了，突然不确定哪些故事是他们被允许重复的。目前为止，我只有一块塞满愤怒笔记的死掉太空劫匪数据板，以及一枚本绝不该带着已退役联殖代码的损坏浮标，两者都指向一只谨慎的手在改写"破损船只该在哪里死去"。

#en: The fields around the abandoned farm should have gone fallow years ago, yet they still glow faintly under the thin sky, stalks whispering against derelict fencing like they are keeping watch. This is where MacLeod drew his line, grafting Kade's designs into desperate soil and then wrapping the place in improvised traps and drilled settlers until it could stand alone. When the crops soured and the militia scattered, someone was meant to come back, sanitize the ground, erase the data, put a clean story on the records. No one did. Now the same quiet war that began with a stray dataslate and hushed testimony in lonely waystations has narrowed to a pattern of armed homesteads, missing reports, and one Scotsman's signature embedded in every security override you have chased across the frontier.
zh: 废弃农场周围的田地本该在多年前就荒废，可它们仍在稀薄的天空下微微发光，茎秆在废弃围栏上沙沙作响，像在放哨。这正是麦克劳德划下界线的地方——他把凯德的设计嫁接进绝望的土壤，再用临时陷阱与被操练过的定居者把这里裹起来，直到它能独自站稳。当作物品变酸、民兵散去后，本该有人回来清理地面、抹掉数据、给记录写上一个干净的故事。没人来。如今，那场始于一块散落数据板与孤独中转站里压低声音证词的安静战争，已收窄成一种由武装农庄、失踪报告，以及一个嵌入你追遍边境的每一处安保覆写中的苏格兰人签名构成的模式。

#en: The lattice of sensors hanging over this forgotten world is not just watching; it is carrying her work between sky and soil, masking chem drops as background noise and laundering signatures for anyone who knows where to look. As long as it hums in the dark, data can be rewritten, blame redirected, and every altered heartbeat below dismissed as bad weather or frontier nerves. Cutting it loose here, above the clouds, is the only way to see which coordinates and dosing schedules were real and which were stories sold to nervous officials. So far, all you have are the relay's corrupted buffers, a stack of quiet autopsies from a grain world, and a smuggler's half-truth about "cleaning agents" routed through a dead station, each source saying less on the record than the evidence on their floors.
zh: 悬在这颗被遗忘世界上方的传感器网格不只是在监视；它在天空与土壤之间运送她的作品，把化学空投伪装成背景噪声，为任何懂得往哪儿看的人洗白签名。只要它仍在黑暗中嗡鸣，数据就能被改写、罪责就能被转移，下方每一声被改动的"心跳"都能被当作坏天气或边境的紧张搪塞过去。在这里、在云层之上把它切断，是看清哪些坐标与给药计划是真的、哪些是卖给紧张官员的故事的唯一办法。目前为止，你只有那座中继损坏的缓冲区、一摞来自某颗谷物世界的安静尸检报告，以及一名走私者关于经由某座死站转运"清洁剂"的半真半假说法——每一处来源在记录上说的，都比它们地板上留的证据要少。

#en: The collapsed command post still smells of burned propellant and dust, a half-buried reminder that someone else already tried to turn the fugitive's patterns into a kill box and paid for the attempt in blood. This is where the planning stopped mid-thought, where maps and firing arcs froze at the moment everything went wrong, and where the only person who truly understood how to spring that trap never came back to refine it. Picking through the rubble here means inheriting their homework and their blind spots both. So far the trail has run from hushed complaints in a freighter den to doctored routes on a drifting GalBank transport and coded betting ledgers tied to Neon's underlevels, all sketching the same three-branched paths and the same ghost navigator dancing just ahead of every ambush.
zh: 那座坍塌的指挥所仍散发着烧焦推进剂与尘土的味道，一个半埋的提醒：另有别人早已试过把那名逃犯的模式变成一个杀伤盒，并为此以血偿付。这里正是计划在思考中途停止的地方，是地图与火力弧在一切出错的那一刻冻结的地方，也是唯一真正懂得如何触发那个陷阱的人再没回来完善它的地方。在这里翻检瓦砾，意味着同时继承他们的作业和他们的盲点。目前为止，线索从某处货船窝点的低声抱怨，延伸到某艘漂移的盖尔银行运输船上被做手脚的航线，再到与霓虹城下层有关的编码赌博账册，全都勾勒出同样的三岔路径与同一个总在每次伏击前方起舞的幽灵领航员。

#en: Behind Ryujin glass and brushed metal, the air tastes sterilized, but the logs buried in their servers still smell of war wards and burned synapses. If any corporation kept a quiet key to the old UC conditioning trees, it would be the one that turned neural tricks into profit, and it would hide that key where only executives and their cleaners ever walk. Security footage loops, access timestamps disagree, and testimony from junior analysts contradicts itself, as if something in the building has been editing memory as efficiently as it edits code. So far, the trail reads like a bad case history: a forgotten slate on a backwater, a dead ship broadcasting mangled orders, a scrubbed SysDef hull, each step tightening around the same medic who never quite stopped following his original directive.
zh: 在龙神的玻璃与拉丝金属之后，空气尝起来经过消毒，可埋在它们服务器里的日志仍带着战地病房与烧焦突触的气味。若说哪家公司保存着一把通往旧联殖心理训导之树的安静钥匙，那一定是把神经把戏变成利润的那家；而它会把那把钥匙藏在只有高管和他们的清洁工才会走过的地方。监控录像循环播放、访问时戳彼此矛盾、初级分析员的证词自相矛盾，仿佛这栋楼里的某样东西在编辑记忆，效率不亚于它编辑代码。目前为止，这条线索读起来像一份糟糕的病例史：一穷乡里一块被遗忘的数据板、一艘广播着错乱命令的死船、一具被擦净的星防队船壳，每一步都收紧着围绕同一名从未真正停下执行最初指令的医疗兵。

#en: Gagarin Landing is where his trail stops pretending to be random burn marks and bad luck and starts to look like design; this is where records, debts, and bloodlines knot together. In the industrial slums, shipwrights, crane operators, and quiet GalBank clerks all touch the same flow of credits and scrap, the perfect place to hide a route back into the graveyard he favors. Someone tried to smother the pattern in doctored yard logs and quiet transfers, but the people here talk after shift, and whispers about a returning tug and familiar sigils have been building for months. So far, the chase has turned up a stray dataslate in the back end of nowhere, a stripped yard full of his marks, and a buried relay full of redacted sensor trails all pointing, indirectly, back to this drift haunted life.
zh: 加加林着陆点，就是他的线索不再假装是随机的烧痕与霉运、而开始显出设计感的地方；这里是记录、债务与血统缠成一结之处。在工业贫民区，造船师、吊车操作员与安静的盖尔银行文书都触碰同一股信用与废料的流动，是把返回他所偏爱墓地的路线藏起来的完美地点。有人试图用被做手脚的船坞日志与安静转账把这个模式闷死，可这里的人下班后会说话，而关于一艘返航拖船与熟悉符印的低语已经积累了好几个月。目前为止，这场追查挖出了天涯之外一块散落数据板、一片布满他标记的被剥光场区，以及一座塞满涂黑传感器轨迹的被埋中继——全都间接指回这种漂浮的闹鬼生活。

#en:
The research module hangs alone over a dead rock, long since scrubbed from official schedules, which is exactly why someone used it to chase a data trail nobody wanted public.  
Here, far from auditors and traffic, logs could be spliced, routes compared, and quiet thefts mapped until the same analyst's name kept appearing just upstream of each "unfortunate" misjump.  
Somewhere in these abandoned consoles is the moment that string of coincidences turned into a pattern, the fork where the watcher stopped believing in random failures.  
So far the hunt has yielded corrupted telemetry from a drifting freighter, a nameless slate pulled off a scavenger, and the half-finished notes of one UC operative who realized too late that all those accidents curved toward the same small set of corridors.
zh:
那座研究舱孤悬在一颗死岩石上方，早已从官方日程里被擦掉——这正是有人用它来追查一条没人希望公开的数据痕迹的原因。  
在这里，远离审计员与交通，日志可以被拼接、航线可以被比对、安静的窃案可以被绘图，直到同一名分析员的名字不断出现在每一次"不幸的"错跳上游。  
在这些被弃置的控制台里的某处，是那串巧合变成模式的那一刻，是那名观察者不再相信随机故障的分岔点。  
目前为止，这场追猎收获了来自一艘漂移货船的损坏遥测、一块从拾荒者身上取下的无名数据板，以及一名联殖特工半途而废的笔记——他太晚才意识到，所有那些事故都弯向同一个小型走廊集合。

#en: The abandoned UC relay bunker is where raw sky is turned into numbers; every patrol, every contrail, every grav ripple once passed through these walls before being scrubbed and forgotten. If those atmospheric scans caught a ship where no ship should have been, this is where the mistake first became data, then secret, then leverage. The deserter chose this place because buried here, in obsolete buffers and mislabelled archives, a single unchecked anomaly could grow into a permanent blind spot that an outlaw navigator could use again and again. All we know so far is that an old listening post showed readings that did not match the public charts, and a missing tech walked away from his station with logs that traced a solitary ship cutting through restricted air above a supposedly quiet sector.
zh: 这座废弃的联殖中继掩体，是把原始天空变成数字的地方；每一次巡逻、每一道凝结尾、每一圈引力涟漪，都曾先穿过这些墙壁，然后被擦净遗忘。若那些大气扫描曾捕捉到一艘不该有船存在的船，这里就是那个错误先变成数据、再变成秘密、再变成筹码的地方。那名逃兵选中这里，是因为埋在废弃缓冲区与标签错乱的档案里，一处无人复核的异常能长成一个永久的盲点，供一名法外领航员反复利用。目前为止我们只知道：一座旧听音哨显示出与公开星图对不上的读数，而一名失踪技师带着日志离开了岗位——那些日志追踪着一艘孤独的船，切过一片据说很安静的星域上方的受限天空。

#en: Neon's underside is where bad numbers finally hit flesh. Down here, beneath the conduction grid's crackle and the trade lights' fake daylight, ledgers are rewritten in back rooms and lives balanced on the edge of a transfer confirmation. This is where Ghostline's edits land in real time, where his clients drink on borrowed names and his proxies watch for hunters on flickering feeds. He has come here to sever his last ties to GalBank and the people he protected, scrubbing trails, collapsing safes, preparing one final set of identities that leave everyone else holding the debt. The trail began with that stray dataslate in the dust, sharpened with orbital anomalies and quiet reversals on backwater worlds, and hardened aboard a silent UC hull where someone had torn ledger code out by the roots.
zh: 霓虹城的下腹，是糟糕数字终于落到血肉上的地方。在这里、"输电网格"的噼啪声与贸易灯光的假白昼之下，账册在后室被重写，人生悬在一笔转账确认的边缘。这里正是"幽灵线"的编辑实时落地之处，是他的客户用借来的名字喝酒、他的代理人盯着闪烁画面搜寻猎人之地。他来这里是为了斩断自己与盖尔银行及他曾保护之人的最后联系：擦净痕迹、清空保险箱、准备最后一批身份，好让其他所有人抱着债务。这条线索始于一尘土中那块散落数据板，随着轨道异常与穷乡世界上安静的止赎撤销而锐化，最终在一具沉默的联殖船壳上硬化——那里有人把账目代码连根拔掉了。

#en: The patrol ship hangs in the dark, systems on minimal draw, like someone wanted it forgotten but not quite dead. This is where accounts were meant to be invisible, buried in routine inspections and quiet corrections that never reach a courtroom. Freestar Security paperwork carries weight out here; if a manifest aboard this hull shows its numbers bent the wrong way, it proves Deadlock has been reaching into law enforcement itself, tilting seizures and releases to suit his unseen ledgers. The crew are gone, but the silence feels practiced, as if anyone who knew too much learned to keep their opinions measured. So far the trail runs from an unmarked slate in the black to cautious whispers at a crowded port, all of it pointing to a single auditor who turned compliance tools into a private noose.
zh: 那艘巡逻舰悬在黑暗中，系统处于最低功耗，像有人希望它被遗忘、却又不完全死掉。这里正是账目本该隐形的地方，埋在例行的检查与从未进过法庭的安静修正里。星联警卫的文书在这外面很有分量；若这具船壳上的一份舱单显示出数字被掰向错误方向，那就证明"死锁"一直在把手伸进执法本身，为迎合他看不见的账册而倾斜查扣与放行。船员不见了，可那份寂静感觉像练过的，仿佛任何知道太多的人都学会了把自己的意见拿捏好。目前为止，线索从漆黑中一块无名数据板，延伸到某座拥挤港市里谨慎的低语，全都指向同一名审计员——他把合规工具变成了一具私人绞索。

#en: For a station that supposedly sees no trouble, the Den has a lot of dark corners where trouble likes to sit and smoke. This is the one place in the Wolf system where corporate route planners, bored Vanguards, and long-haul captains all pass through the same airlock and quietly adjust their stories before they file them. Somewhere in those half-redacted reports and "misplaced" briefing notes is the first honest trace of who has been rewriting jump profiles and why the mishaps all curve the same way, but no one wants to be the one who admits they saw it. Up to now the trail is thin: a bitter hauler's log on a dead rock, a whisper about a nameless navigator who fixes jumps too well, and a growing sense that the margins on official maps are where the real work gets done and then quietly forgotten.
zh: 对于一座据说从不出事的星际站来说，"巢穴站"有太多黑暗角落能让麻烦坐下抽烟。这是沃尔夫星系里唯一一个企业航线规划员、无聊的先锋队员与长途船长都会穿过同一道气闸、并在提交报告前悄悄调整自己说法的地方。在那些半涂黑的报告与"放错位置"的简报笔记里的某处，藏着第一条诚实的痕迹：谁在改写跃迁剖面、为何那些小事故都朝同样方向弯折——可没人愿意当那个承认自己看见过的人。目前为止，这条线索很稀薄：一块死岩石上一名愤懑货船船员的日志、一则关于某个把跃迁修得太好的无名领航员的低语，以及一种越来越强的感觉——官方星图的页边，才是真正的工作被完成、然后被悄悄遗忘的地方。

#en: Out here, the telemetry buoy hangs on the edge of mapped space, still spitting half-corrupted readings into a network that long ago stopped listening. It is the kind of infrastructure nobody owns loudly, a relic patched by whoever was on shift that day, every minor adjustment and misread echo compounding into a ghost corridor he has learned to exploit. Clearing this node out of the sky will strip away one more layer of confusion he hides behind and force the truth of his routes to stand on its own. So far I have a dead settlement on bad coordinates, a silenced cargo hull that slipped through Trade Authority checks on a clerical shrug, and a murmur from Neon's forgotten machinery, all hinting that his greatest allies are not people at all, but the small mistakes everyone else leaves uncorrected.
zh: 在这里，那座遥测浮标悬在已测绘太空的边缘，仍在朝一张早已停止聆听的网络吐着半损坏的读数。它是那种没人会大声宣称自己拥有的基础设施，一件被当天值班者随手打过补丁的遗物，每一处细微调整与误读的回声都累积成一条他学会利用的幽灵走廊。把这枚节点从天空中清除，会剥掉他藏身的又一层混乱，并迫使他航线的真相独自站住。目前为止，我有一颗坐标不对的死掉定居点、一具"靠文书一耸肩"溜过贸易管理局检查的被噤声货船壳，以及来自霓虹城被遗忘机械的一声低语，全都暗示他最得力的盟友根本不是人，而是别人留下未纠正的那些小错误。

#en: This is where the storm finally has nowhere left to run. The thin air claws at every seal, dust riding the wind like ground glass, and the small civilian shelter beneath you is the last place in this system that can still see the sky clearly enough to feed Stormline the data she needs. Here she has been stitching together live readings and half-broken instruments into one last corridor, a final route that could spirit war criminals, black ledgers, or entire settlements off official charts if she finishes her work. Cut the link here and the map dies with her. All anyone can say for certain is that it started with scattered settler reports at a Ranger outpost, then a dead UC warship haunted by her old callsign, each hint pointing toward a pilot who rides storms and erases the evidence behind her.
zh: 这里正是风暴终于无处可逃的地方。稀薄的空气抓挠着每一道密封，尘土像碎玻璃一样乘风而行，而你脚下那座小型民用避难所，是这个星系里最后一处仍能足够清晰地看见天空、从而给"风暴线"送去她所需数据的地方。她在这里一直在把实时读数与半坏的仪器缝成最后一条走廊——一条若她完成工作、就能把战犯、黑账册或整片定居点送出官方星图的最终航线。在这里切断连接，那张地图就与她同亡。所有人能确定的只有：它始于游骑兵前哨处零散的定居者报告，然后是一艘被她旧呼号纠缠的死掉联殖军舰，每一处线索都指向一名驾驭风暴、并在身后抹掉证据的飞行员。

#en: Out here, hanging just off the main lanes where patrol sweeps grow thin and transponders blur into background noise, the small things that steer whole convoys never make it back to official charts; they live in quiet emitters, forgotten buoys, and the kind of ship that survives by hauling scrap through blind spots. Whatever signal is tucked into this orbit was placed with her kind of precision, bending jump solutions a fraction at a time until frightened captains start calling the detour normal and everyone else decides not to ask why. So far the trail is a salvaged dataslate on a backwater rock, wreck reports that share the same odd entry vector, freight logs on Jemison that agree a little too neatly, and now a relay that seems to hum on a frequency halfway between superstition and convenience.
zh: 在这里，就悬在主航道外、巡逻圈变稀薄、应答器模糊进背景噪声之处，那些操纵整支车队的小东西从不曾回到官方星图上；它们活在安静的发射器、被遗忘的浮标，以及那种靠把废料运过盲点而幸存下来的船里。藏在这条轨道里的任何信号，都是以她那种精度布置的：一次一点点地掰弯跃迁解，直到受惊的船长开始把绕行当作常态，而其他所有人决定不问为什么。目前为止，这条线索是一块来自穷乡岩石的回收数据板、分享同一个古怪入射向量的残骸报告、杰米森星上一致得过于整齐的货运日志，以及如今一座似乎在"迷信与便利之间"某个频率上嗡鸣的中继。

#en: The Windcrier TA-6451 drifts just off the lanes, a dead Trade Authority hauler turned hollow echo chamber for every bad deal that ever rode its wake. Its hull is scarred but intact, systems left in that uneasy state between powered down and waiting, as if someone wanted the ship to vanish from manifests without quite letting it die. Buried in its nav banks and sealed cargo nodes is the pattern you have been circling around since the first whispered mention of a corridor that cheats fuel and fate, the thread that links a single grav-cartographer's private obsession to ships disappearing along an unmarked line in space. This is where her work touched official trade, where quiet compromises and small shortcuts stacked up until whole crews went missing and a routine drink in Neon turned into a hunt.
zh: 风呼者 TA-6451就漂在航道外，一艘死掉的贸易管理局货船变成了中空的回声室，回荡着每一笔曾搭它顺风车的坏交易。它的船壳伤痕累累却完好，系统停留在"已关机"与"在等待"之间那种不安的状态，仿佛有人想让这艘船从舱单上消失、却又不完全让它死去。埋在它导航库与密封货舱节点里的，是你自从第一次听到"一条能骗过燃料与命运的走廊"的低语以来就一直在绕圈的那个模式，那根把一名引力制图师的私人执念与沿着太空中一条未标注线消失的船只系起来的线。这里是她的作品接触官方贸易的地方，是安静的妥协与小小的抄近路层层叠加、直到整队船员失踪、霓虹城一次寻常饮酒变成一场追猎的地方。

#en: On a station born from an old political betrayal and repurposed as a sanctuary, the paperwork is supposed to be pristine, every vial and patient accounted for. Yet tucked between legitimate treatment routes and research transfers lies a forked set of records, one chain feeding corporate buyers, the other ghosting toward places that no longer appear on official charts. Untangling which path belongs to Catalyst and which to those trying to erase her means committing to a version of her story that has been retold, redacted, and twisted by fear in every retelling. So far, the trail runs from a stripped courier loaded with misrouted chems to veterans whispering about a medic who appears where supply lines fail, each account overlapping just enough to prove she is real before drifting into superstition.
zh: 在一座诞生于旧日政治背叛、后被改作庇护所的星际站上，文书本该一尘不染，每一瓶药剂、每一名病人都要登记在案。然而在合法治疗路线与研究转运之间，藏着一套分岔的记录：一条链喂给企业买家，另一条则幽灵般流向那些不再出现在官方星图上的地方。弄清哪条路属于"催化剂"、哪条属于试图抹掉她的人，意味着你得认定她故事的一个版本——而那个版本在每一次重述中都被复述、被涂黑、被恐惧扭曲。目前为止，线索从一艘塞满错投药剂的被剥光信使船，延伸到老兵们关于一名"在补给线失效处现身"的医疗兵的低语，每一份叙述的重叠都刚好足以证明她真实存在，随后又飘进迷信。

#en: The spaceport is where all the quiet manipulations become visible, if you know where to look. Docking queues, waiver slips, delayed clearances the staff grumble about and then accept as "just how it is" all pass through the terminals here. Whatever routes have been bent to shelter a ghost banker and his clients will be encoded in these comings and goings, hidden in the rhythm of freighters that always seem to get a berth when others wait. Strip that pattern bare and you not only narrow the search, you also threaten the leverage he holds over every captain on his leash. So far the trail has gone from a dead slate in the black to hushed hints at a crowded port, and enough unlikely overlaps between pirate strikes and redirected traffic that coincidences piled up until they stopped feeling like chance.
zh: 太空港，正是所有安静的操弄变得可见的地方——如果你知道该往哪儿看。停靠队列、豁免单、员工一边抱怨一边当作"本来就这样"接受下来的延迟放行，全都经过这里的终端。凡是被掰弯来庇护一名幽灵银行家及其客户的航线，都会被编码进这些来来往往，藏在那些总能在别人等候时拿到泊位的货船的节奏里。把那个模式剥出来，你不仅能收窄搜索，还能威胁到他套在每一名船长脖子上的那个筹码。目前为止，线索从漆黑中一块死掉的数据板，到某座拥挤港市里压低的暗示，再到海盗袭击与被改道交通之间足够多不太可能的交叠——巧合越堆越高，直到不再觉得像偶然。

#en: It had to end where the numbers were first twisted into silence. The tower was built to make distant stars predictable, its labs full of instruments that could have proved or disproved everything long before ships started coming apart in grav space. Someone scrubbed the records instead, sealed floors, reassigned staff, and pretended the strange neurology reports were statistical noise. Vector came back here because this is where the oversight began, where a regulator can be tuned to push past every safety margin and broadcast one last, catastrophic data point to the Settled Systems. Rumors from a backworld informant, broken orbital telemetry, then redacted reports pried loose from that quiet annex below New Atlantis all pointed here as the place the truth was buried and the whispers refused to die.
zh: 它必须终结在数字第一次被拧成沉默的地方。那座塔是为让遥远群星变得可预测而建的，它的实验室里满是本可以在船只开始在引力空间中解体之前很久就证明或推翻一切的工具。可有人反而擦净了记录、封了楼层、调走了人员，并假装那些古怪的神经学报告只是统计噪声。"向量"回到这里，是因为监督正是从此处开始，是因为在这里，一个调节器能被调校到越过每一道安全边际，并向定居星系广播最后一个灾难性的数据点。来自一穷乡线人的传闻、损坏的轨道遥测，然后是从新亚特兰蒂斯城下方那个安静附属机构撬出的涂黑报告，全都指向这里——真相被埋葬之处，也是低语拒绝死去之处。

#en: The old garrison hangs over the landscape like a verdict that was never delivered, its comm towers dead yet still watching the lanes. UC pulled out years ago, but the infrastructure remains intact enough for someone who understands traffic systems to turn it into a private command deck, a place to rewrite who lives and dies between the stars. Here, Vector can tap forgotten sensor grids and encrypted relays, clearing one final corridor for herself while collapsing others behind her. If she finishes purging the archives and seizing that data, entire sectors will never know why their routes failed. All we have so far are a lost dataslate from the fringe, fuel records that do not match declared paths, and a derelict scout ship whose logs show elegant, impossible courses repeating the same careful hand.
zh: 那座旧驻军像一份从未宣判的裁决悬在大地之上，它的通讯塔已死，却仍在注视航道。联殖多年前就撤走了，可基础设施保存得足够完好，让一个懂交通系统的人能把它变成私人指挥甲板，一个可以改写群星之间谁生谁死的地方。在这里，"向量"能接入被遗忘的传感器网格与加密中继，为自己清出最后一条走廊，同时把其他走廊在身后塌掉。若她完成对档案的清除并夺取那些数据，整片整片星区将永远不知道自己的航线为何失败。目前为止，我们只有一块来自边境的丢失数据板、与申报路径对不上的燃料记录，以及一艘弃置侦察船——它的日志显示出优雅而不可能的航线，重复着同一只谨慎的手。

#en: This lonely orbit is where the story first bent out of shape, a derelict drifting just far enough off its projected path to bother the right kind of analyst. Whatever is broadcasting from this husk is not a simple hazard beacon; it is a rewritten script, carving safe corridors for some ships and blind spots for others, burying its alterations in the noise of ordinary telemetry. If this pattern keeps spreading unchecked, every later disappearance will be blamed on bad luck and old war debris, and whatever really happened will be argued over in bars instead of logged in reports. So far, all you have is a half-corrupted dataslate from a forgotten outpost and a handful of drone diagnostics that repeat the same strange signature, enough to prove someone is tampering with the lanes, not enough to say who.
zh: 这条孤独的轨道，就是故事最初走形的地方：一具弃船漂得刚好偏离预测路径，足以让对路子的分析员在意。从这具残骸里广播出来的不是什么简单的危险信标；它是一段被改写的脚本，为某些船切出安全走廊、为另一些切出盲点，把它的改动埋进普通遥测的噪声里。若这个模式继续不受控地扩散，之后每一次失踪都会被归咎于霉运与旧战争残骸，而真正发生的事将只会在酒吧里被争论，而不是被记录在报告里。目前为止，你只有一块来自被遗忘前哨的半损坏数据板，以及几份重复着同一古怪签名的无人机诊断——足以证明有人在动航道的手脚，却不足以说明是谁。

#en: This patch of orbit looks harmless at a glance, just another empty lane ships cut through on their way to more important places, and that is exactly why it works. When a system gets logged as safe often enough, pilots stop checking the numbers, supervisors stop re-running the stress models, and anything slipped into that blind spot can run for years without a second look. If Torque has been testing how far he can push grav fields before they scream, it would be out here, where routine bred laziness. So far I have a blurred chain: a half-forgotten surface log about anomalous spin, an unregistered cache adrift where no one should have built anything, and a growing list of ships with drive readings that do not match their flight histories, all pointing toward someone quietly using our habits against us.
zh: 这片轨道乍看人畜无害，不过是船只在前往更要紧之地途中切过的又一条空航道——而这正是它奏效的原因。当一个系统被足够频繁地登记为安全，飞行员就不再核对数字，主管就不再重跑应力模型，而溜进那个盲点的任何东西都能运行多年而无人再看第二眼。如果"扭矩"一直在测试引力场在被逼到尖叫之前能推多远，那就会是在这里，在这种例行公事养出惰性之处。目前为止，我有一条模糊的链条：一份关于异常自旋的半遗忘地面日志、一处漂在没人该建任何东西之处的未登记储藏点，以及一份越来越长的、引擎读数与飞行史不符的船只清单——全都指向有人在悄悄利用我们的习惯对付我们。

#en: Out here, pinned in quiet orbit above anonymous cloud and rock, is the one place his adjustments can be seen without all the planetary noise. Away from port auditors and Harmonization filters, the traffic offsets he sold to pirates and nervous captains resolve into clean geometry, revealing which windows were genuine rescues and which were sharpened into blades. Whoever helped him build this layer of the scheme made sure no one on the ground had to say its name; the absence in every report is almost louder than the data. So far, the trail runs through a forgotten dataslate, a compromised courier, and a scrubbed Navy patrol, then down into the under-levels of New Atlantis where his habits began; each step tightening the circle around a man who moves ships by leaving all the most important words unsaid.
zh: 在这里，钉在无名云层与岩石上方的安静轨道中，是他那些调整唯一能在没有全部行星噪声的情况下被看到的地方。远离港口审计员与"协调过滤器"，他卖给海盗与紧张船长的交通偏移解析成干净的几何，揭示哪些窗口是真正的救援、哪些被磨成了刀刃。帮他搭起这一层方案的人确保了地面上没人需要说出它的名字；每一份报告里的那种缺席，几乎比数据本身更响。目前为止，这条线索穿过一块被遗忘的数据板、一艘被攻陷的信使船，以及一支被擦净的海军巡逻队，再向下钻进新亚特兰蒂斯城的下层——他的习惯正是从那里开始的；每一步都收紧着围绕一个人的圆圈——他靠把最重要的那些词全部略去来移动船只。

#en: Out here, in a base the UC forgot even before the paint peeled, the wrong kind of tech can sit unnoticed for years, passed from one petty outfit to the next until it becomes part of the scenery. The Razor Strays are not guarding this place for nostalgia; they are guarding something they barely understand, inherited from some old officer who never filed the right shut-down order. Left alone, it will keep seeding the lanes with bad math and worse ideas for anyone willing to pay. So far the trail has been a stack of small mistakes a corrupted slate on a lonely rock, a "clerical error" in a Trade Authority hold, half-sanitized sims in a bunker like this each one an oversight someone thought they would fix later, each one another step in the path of a navigator who learned how to turn neglect into a weapon.
zh: 在这里、在一座联殖在油漆剥落之前就已遗忘的基地里，那种"错误的"技术能多年无人注意地坐着，被从一支小队伍传给下一支，直到成为风景的一部分。剃刀流浪帮守在这里不是为了怀旧；他们守着一件自己几乎不理解的东西，是从某个从未提交正确关停令的老军官那里继承来的。任其自生自灭，它会继续为任何愿意付钱的人在航道里播下坏数学与更坏的点子。目前为止，这条线索是一摞小错误：孤独岩石上一块损坏的数据板、贸易管理局货舱里的一处"文书记录错误"、像这样一座掩体里半清理过的模拟——每一处都是有人以为以后再修的疏忽，每一处都是那名学会把忽视变成武器的领航员路径上的又一步。

#en: Down here the ceilings sweat and the walls carry every rumor; this is where routes get rewritten for credits, and where someone like him would hide a key inside ordinary traffic. In the Well, shiphands, off-duty LIST clerks, and GalBank debtors all move through the same narrow corridors, their secrets pressed close, their voices kept low so no analyst up top can triangulate loose talk. Whatever pattern he left pointing toward that hidden homestead would have to pass through a place like this, disguised as a scrap of nav code or a forgotten contract, buried where only those already drowning in numbers would dare to look. So far the trail runs from a stray dataslate in the black, to corrupted orbitals, to whispered mentions of failed basins and a pilot who keeps turning safe worlds into statistical ghosts.
zh: 在这下面，天花板在渗水，墙壁承载着每一则传闻；这里是航线为信用币被改写的地方，也是像他那样的人会把一把钥匙藏进寻常交通里的地方。在深井区，船工、休班的独立盟文书与盖尔银行欠债人都在同样的狭窄走廊里移动，他们的秘密贴身藏紧，把声音压低，好让上面任何分析员都无法三角定位闲话。他留下来指向那座隐藏农庄的任何模式，都必然要经过这样的地方，伪装成一小段导航代码或一份被遗忘的合同，埋在那里——只有那些已经淹死在数字里的人敢去看。目前为止，线索从漆黑中一块散落数据板，到损坏的轨道数据，再到关于失败盆地与一名不断把安全世界变成统计幽灵的飞行员那些低语的提及。

#en: The trail starts in this quiet research module because this is where someone first tried to erase the lines she drew and failed. The stolen routing work that passed through these servers did not vanish, it smeared its fingerprints across cached telemetry, half-scrubbed backups, and error logs no one bothered to purge. If she hijacked a data-theft chain here, then the patterns she was hiding from and the ones she was creating both brushed the same systems, leaving just enough residue for someone patient to reconstruct a direction of travel.
